DIRECTOR, STRATEGIC FINANCE

Who is a Director, Strategic Finance?

The Director, Strategic Finance is a high-impact leader within the Office of the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who brings an investment-oriented perspective to GoodLife Group’s most consequential strategic, financial and enterprise-value decisions. This role personally leads complex analysis and selected cross-functional workstreams under the delegated authority of the CFO.
Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, the role expands the capacity and analytical depth of the Office of the CFO across executive decision support, capital allocation, enterprise performance, Value Creation Plan validation, Apollo and Board engagement, financing and merger and acquisition (M&A) execution.

Working with leadership from across Financial Planning & Analysis, Accounting, Data & Analytics and Operations departments, the role influences through expertise, credibility and delegated CFO authority, while functional leaders retain ownership of their teams, source information and recurring processes.

What will you be doing?

Enterprise strategic finance, corporate modelling and capital allocation

  • Build, enhance and apply integrated financial models, strategic scenarios and sensitivity analyses that connect operating performance, cash flow, leverage, capital requirements, and enterprise value.
  • Evaluate organic growth initiatives, capital projects, acquisitions, financing alternatives and other uses of capital through disciplined return, risk, liquidity and enterprise-value analysis; establish appropriate post investment performance reviews.
  • Translate complex financial, operational and market information into clear alternatives, trade-offs and recommendations for the CFO, CEO, and executive leadership.

Apollo, Board and lender performance insight

  • Lead the financial synthesis, analytical challenge and development of decision-useful performance narratives for selected Apollo, Board and lender discussions, while the CFO remains the primary relationship owner and existing teams retain responsibility for underlying financial information.
  • Integrate and constructively challenge inputs from Financial Planning & Analysis, Accounting, Data & Analytics and operating teams to identify key drivers, emerging risks, outlook implications and required decisions
  • Partner with the CFO and executive leadership to articulate clear financial narratives regarding business performance, strategic priorities, risks, and opportunities.
  • Lead selected follow-up analyses and coordinate timely resolution of material questions, commitments and decisions arising from Apollo, Board and lender discussions.

M&A, financing and strategic transaction execution

  • Lead core financial analysis and selected execution workstreams for acquisitions, dispositions, refinancing's and other strategic transactions, including screening, valuation, financial modelling, due diligence, scenario analysis and approval materials.
  • Support the CFO in evaluating capital structure, liquidity requirements, financing alternatives, and capital-allocation priorities.
  • Coordinate Finance workstreams, data-room requirements and financial analysis across internal teams, financing sources, counterparties and external advisors.
  • Evaluate transaction structures, synergies, risks, integration considerations and value-creation implications, and support post transaction performance tracking where appropriate.

Executive decision support and Office of the CFO effectiveness

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the CFO on high-priority strategic, financial and operational matters.
  • Lead selected cross-functional strategic workstreams and high-priority analyses, bringing investment discipline, structure, pace and clear accountability to complex or ambiguous issues.
  • Support the financial elements of the Value Creation Plan, including connecting initiative impacts to the long-range financial model, validating material financial assumptions and supporting the reporting cadence for key financial and operating KPIs, without assuming ownership of broader VCP governance or initiative execution.
  • Institutionalize rigorous decision and review processes for priority Office of the CFO mandates, including clear accountabilities, analytical standards and escalation protocols.
  • Build trusted relationships with long-tenured leaders and ensure that Strategic Finance complements, rather than cuts across, the responsibilities of existing functional teams.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, accounting, mathematics, engineering or another quantitatively rigorous discipline
  • 4 to 7 years of progressively responsible experience in private equity, investment banking, pension or infrastructure investing, strategic finance or another analytically rigorous transaction- or investment-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building and interpreting complex financial models, evaluating investments or transactions, and preparing concise decision materials for senior executives, investment committees, Boards or equivalent senior stakeholders
  • Advanced financial modelling, valuation, investment-return analysis, scenario analysis and business-case development skills, with expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to create concise, executive-quality PowerPoint materials.
  • Deep understanding of the connections among income statement performance, balance sheet requirements, cash flow, liquidity, leverage, covenants and enterprise value.
  • Exceptional analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, test assumptions, distinguish material issues from noise and reconcile information from multiple sources.
  • Exceptional written, verbal and presentation communication skills, including the ability to produce concise, persuasive, executive- and Board-quality materials.
  • Credibility, judgment, and executive presence to work directly with senior leaders, investors, lenders and advisors while handling confidential information appropriately.
  • Highly self-directed, organized and action oriented; able to manage multiple workstreams, tight deadlines and ambiguity without requiring a large team or extensive direction.
  • A hands-on orientation and willingness to move between high-level strategic questions and detailed analysis and execution.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional work through expertise, credibility and delegated authority rather than formal hierarchy.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding GoodLife’s businesses at the club, member and operating-process levels.

What’s in it for you?

· Ongoing training & development to ensure a long & successful career path

· Career advancement opportunities

· Competitive Total Rewards Package

· FREE Performance Fitness membership

· Fun & energetic atmosphere to come to every day!

About OpsGuru & The Project

OpsGuru is a cloud consultancy that helps enterprises design, build, secure, and operate modern platforms on major public clouds. Our teams combine deep engineering capability with the governance discipline demanded by highly regulated environments.

In this role, you will join an OpsGuru delivery team on a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) enablement project for a Canadian financial services client. You will build the secure, compliant GCP foundation required to host production and AI workloads.

Role Summary

As a Senior GCP Platform Enablement Engineer, you will design and implement infrastructure, identity, networking, and security controls that enable safe, enterprise-scale adoption of cloud services. You will codify all infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, policies, and compliance guardrails to deliver a repeatable, auditable platform ready for regulatory oversight.

You will collaborate closely with the client's Security, IAM, Networking, Architecture, and Operations teams to translate business requirements into working platform capabilities, concluding with complete documentation and knowledge transfer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, reusable Terraform modules for GCP organization, folder, project, and service resources.
  • CI/CD Automation: Develop pipelines that plan, test, scan, and deploy infrastructure and policy changes with approval gates and audit trails.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Implement IAM, RBAC, and least-privilege models, including service account lifecycles, Workload Identity, and privileged access patterns.
  • Enterprise Networking: Build and secure VPCs (including Shared VPCs), firewall policies, Cloud DNS, and private connectivity (Private Service Connect, Interconnect, VPN).
  • Security Hardening: Apply STIG and/or CIS benchmarks and implement enterprise security controls across the platform and its services.
  • Policy & Compliance as Code: Define and enforce guardrails using GCP Organization Policy, OPA/Rego, Terraform policy checks, or equivalent tooling to provide audit-ready evidence.
  • Service Enablement: Onboard enterprise cloud and platform services into production along with the controls, patterns, and runbooks needed for safe consumption.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Handover: Facilitate design sessions, present technical decisions, and deliver comprehensive documentation and training to customer teams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Terraform & IaC: Proven hands-on experience structuring modular Terraform within enterprise GCP environments.
  • CI/CD: Experience building automation pipelines for infrastructure delivery and testing.
  • IAM & Security: Strong grasp of GCP IAM, RBAC, service account management, and security controls.
  • Networking: Expertise in GCP enterprise networking (Shared VPCs, firewalls, Cloud DNS, Private Service Connect/Interconnect/VPN).
  • Compliance Standards: Hands-on experience implementing STIG and/or CIS benchmarks.
  • Policy/Compliance as Code: Experience enforcing platform guardrails programmatically (OPA/Rego, Org Policy, Terraform policy checks).
  • Production Enablement: Track record of enabling cloud platform services in enterprise production environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with Security, IAM, Networking, Architecture, and Operations teams.
  • Communication: Excellent technical writing and stakeholder management skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Gemini Enterprise implementation or enablement.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification.
  • Experience in banking, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes.
  • Experience onboarding AI services into enterprise environments.

Additional Engagement Details

Job Title: Remote Exercise Physiologist

Classification: 1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Schedule/Shift: 20-40 hours per week, between Monday-Friday 8am-10pm ET; Saturday/Sunday 9am-3pm ET

Team: Intensive Cardiac Rehabilitation

Reporting to: Clinical Staff Program Manager/Senior Manager of Cardiac Rehab

Location: United States

Compensation: $20-$30 per patient session (30 and 60 minute sessions available)

Position Overview:

The Remote Exercise Physiologist plays a pivotal role in supporting patients enrolled in our cardiac rehabilitation program. The role focuses on providing exercise programming, as well as helping patients navigate through the program through goal setting, progression tracking, and providing education and guidance on heart-healthy lifestyles. The Remote Exercise Physiologist will also support patients in managing their recovery post-cardiac event. The Remote Exercise Physiologist will work closely with a multidisciplinary team including nurses, exercise physiologists, and dietitians to provide comprehensive care for patients in various stages of recovery.

Responsibilities:

  1. Patient Assessment and Monitoring:
    • Perform comprehensive health assessments of cardiac rehab patients, including physical fitness, medical history, lifestyle habits, and psychological wellbeing.
    • Monitor patients' progress and adjust rehabilitation plans as needed, tracking metrics such as exercise tolerance, heart rate, and blood pressure.
  2. Personalized Care:
    • Work with patients on exercises for our focus populations, typically older adults with cardiovascular issues (over telehealth/video conferencing platform)
    • Implement exercise plans according to current professional and organization standards
    • Review patients progress, evaluating compliance and patient response to exercise
    • Lead group exercise sessions for individuals with similar health issues
    • Update group exercise programming in collaboration with the clinical operations team and medical director
    • Document all information in an accurate, concise, and timely manner
  3. Behavioral Coaching:
    • Offer motivation and emotional support to patients, addressing any concerns or barriers to following their rehabilitation plan.
    • Utilize cognitive-behavioral strategies to help patients overcome challenges, such as anxiety, depression, or lack of motivation.
    • Identify and address barriers that would hinder program completion.
  4. Education and Counseling:
    • Provide counseling on lifestyle modifications, including smoking cessation, dietary changes, stress reduction, and medication adherence.
    • Provide education on cardiovascular health, nutrition, and stress management, promoting heart-healthy behaviors.
    • Promote the importance of regular attendance in the program
    • Sign patients up for group education classes.
    • Identify barriers to group education participation.
  5. Collaborative Care:
    • Work closely with a multidisciplinary team, including cardiologists, nurses, physical therapists, and dietitians, to ensure comprehensive care for each patient.
    • Provide regular updates on patient progress and challenges to the healthcare team.
  2. Data Collection and Documentation:
    • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient assessments, progress, and communication.
    • Record relevant data for tracking and reporting on program outcomes, patient goals, and adherence to the rehab plan.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Health, Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or related field.
  • Certifications:.
    • CPR and First Aid certification.
    • *ACSM or AACVPR Certification is a requirement - either Certified Cardiac Rehabilitation Professional (CCRP), Certified Exercise Physiologist (EP-C), Clinical Exercise Physiologist (CEP) or Registered Clinical Exercise Physiologist (RCEP)
  • Experience:
    • Experience working in a clinical or rehabilitation setting, ideally with cardiac patients.
    • Experience leading Group classes or Group Fitness Instructor
  • Skills:
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex medical information in an understandable way.
    • Knowledge of cardiovascular disease management, exercise prescription, and behavior change techniques.
    • Empathy and patience for patients with varying physical and emotional challenges.
  • Other Qualities:
    • Motivational and goal-oriented approach to patient care.
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills.

*Note: This is a 1099 contractor position

Smule has been on a mission to bring the world together through music since 2008. Music is much more than listening… it's about creating, sharing, discovering, participating, and connecting with people. With dozens of millions of monthly active users creating over 20 million songs every day, Smule is connecting people all over the world through the joy of making music and transforming the music landscape from one of passive listening to collaborative creative expression and active engagement.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models in production at Smule, from training and optimization through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will work closely with research scientists to bring models off the bench and into scalable, reliable systems that serve millions of users. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer first, with deep practical knowledge of ML systems, a passion for reliability, and an eye for performance.

We strongly encourage candidates with non-traditional backgrounds to apply. If your path into ML engineering came through backend systems, DevOps, audio software, data engineering, or another field, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain production ML pipelines encompassing data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Optimize models for production constraints including latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost, using techniques such as quantization, distillation, pruning, and efficient serving architectures.
  • Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for deployed models, covering data drift, prediction quality, and system health.
  • Collaborate with research scientists to integrate new model architectures and training techniques into production systems with minimal friction.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for ML, including automated testing, validation gates, and staged rollouts.
  • Manage compute infrastructure and costs, making informed tradeoffs between performance, reliability, and budget.

What We're Looking For:

  • Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or currently pursuing one.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning serving (TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of systems engineering: networking, storage, containerization, orchestration, and monitoring.
  • Ability to reason about tradeoffs between latency, throughput, cost, and model quality.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience serving large language models or other generative models at scale.
  • Familiarity with audio/music processing pipelines and real-time inference constraints.
  • Experience with Bayesian optimization, bandit algorithms, or adaptive experimentation platforms.
  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.

Write the content that defines the industry. Berry Law is seeking an exceptional licensed attorney to serve as our Senior Legal Content Creator—a trusted legal writer, strategist, and editor responsible for shaping the firm's thought leadership across every major communication channel. This is not a traditional legal marketing position, nor is it a practicing attorney role. We are looking for someone who can transform complex legal issues into authoritative, compelling content that educates Veterans, builds trust, strengthens Berry Law's national reputation, and creates meaningful business impact. You'll become the firm's editorial authority—someone trusted to write with the precision, judgment, and sophistication expected of an experienced attorney while maintaining Berry Law's voice, ethical standards, and commitment to excellence. If you're the type of attorney who enjoys writing, teaching, researching, and influencing far more than litigation or managing a caseload, this may be the ideal opportunity.

What You'll Do

Lead Berry Law's Editorial Strategy

  • Conduct original legal research and develop authoritative studies, reports, and white papers.
  • Write thought leadership articles that establish Berry Law as a national authority in Veterans Disability and Personal Injury law.
  • Develop editorial calendars aligned with firm priorities, legislative developments, and strategic initiatives.

Own High-Value Content Creation

  • Draft long-form website content, practice area pages, legal guides, and educational resources.
  • Write executive thought leadership pieces, opinion articles, and media-ready content.
  • Draft persuasive copy that allows Berry Law to capitalize quickly on breaking news and emerging media opportunities.
  • Provide ongoing website news updates and timely legal commentary.

Drive Multimedia Storytelling

  • Develop podcast content plans, episode outlines, and interview preparation materials.
  • Write video scripts, storyboards, and production briefs for educational and brand campaigns.
  • Collaborate with the Producer to ensure every piece of content tells a compelling story.

Elevate Every Communication

  • Develop messaging for social media campaigns, email initiatives, public relations, and executive communications.
  • Review and edit content to ensure legal accuracy, editorial excellence, and brand consistency.
  • Serve as the firm's final editorial resource for complex legal content.

Protect Berry Law's Reputation

  • Ensure every published piece reflects Berry Law's brand standards, legal ethics, and commitment to serving Veterans.
  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail while simplifying complex legal concepts for everyday readers.
  • Create content that earns trust, not clicks.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school
  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction
  • Exceptional legal writing and editing abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly for professional and consumer audiences
  • Outstanding research, organization, and editorial judgment
  • Ability to translate sophisticated legal concepts into compelling, reader-friendly content

Preferred

  • Experience developing thought leadership or educational legal content
  • Familiarity with SEO, content strategy, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI-assisted research
  • Experience working with Veteran or military communities
  • Background collaborating with marketing, media, or communications teams

Who Will Thrive Here

This role is ideal for an attorney who...

  • Loves writing more than billing hours.
  • Notices grammatical mistakes before finishing the sentence.
  • Can edit complex legal writing into something anyone can understand.
  • Thinks strategically about education, persuasion, and influence.
  • Enjoys researching emerging legal issues and turning them into compelling stories.
  • Takes pride in producing work that becomes the standard—not just another blog post.

Why Berry Law?

Berry Law is a nationally recognized, veteran-led law firm committed to serving those who served. We're looking for more than a writer—we're looking for someone John Berry can trust with his law license, the firm's reputation, and its voice. You'll have the opportunity to shape the legal conversation, influence thousands of readers every day, and produce the kind of content that defines an industry—not simply follows it. If you're looking to use your legal expertise to educate, influence, and build something lasting, we'd love to meet you.

Job Title: Consultant, Offline

Position Reports to: US Director, Media Performance and Operations

Location: Remote- Guatemala Based

About Ebiquity:

Ebiquity is the world leader in media investment analysis. We harness the power of data to provide independent, fact-based advice, enabling brand owners to perfect media investment decisions and improve business outcomes.

We are a data-driven solutions company helping brand owners drive efficiency and effectiveness from their media spend, eliminating wastage and creating value.

We provide analysis and solutions through five Service lines:

  • Media Management
  • Media Performance
  • Marketing Effectiveness
  • Technology Advisory
  • Contract Compliance

Ebiquity is able to provide independent, unbiased advice and solutions to brands because we have no commercial interest in any part of the media supply chain.

More than 500 media specialists operate from our 18 offices across 14 countries, covering 80% of the global advertising market.

Ebiquity has the most comprehensive, independent view of today’s global media market. We analyze $55bn of media spend from 75 markets annually, including trillions of digital media impressions.

Our Contract Compliance division, Firm-Decisions, audits $40bn of contract value annually. As a result, more than 70 of the world’s top 100 advertisers today choose Ebiquity as their trusted independent media advisor.

We want the best talent available, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, disability or age.

What is the purpose of the role?

This role will be joining our US Media Performance team, which works across a varied high-profile list of clients. You will produce data-driven insights across a variety of media auditing services including media cost & quality benchmarking, agency pitch reviews, savings verification, and media consulting.

This position requires liaising with agencies, presenting findings to clients, and contributing to the development of new business. You will be a core part of the team, with a very active and significant role in the company where you will see daily proof of the impact of your ideas and contributions as well as bolster Ebiquity’s position in the US Market as a prominent consultancy practice. Helping senior client stakeholders understand the offline world, identify the best shape for their investment, and train and consult with them on an ongoing basis.

We seek a candidate with strong independent leadership skills that is capable of sharing, teaching, and enhancing holistic media knowledge across the US team.

Key activities:

  • Confidently present and provide advice to your clients across a variety of US media channels with focus on US National TV with experience in digital a plus

  • Provide client account management support, assist client leads in commercial decisions, contract renewals, and client business planning
  • Assist client leads in identifying opportunities to expand our remit with key clients and introduc them to other Ebiquity services

What will you bring to the role?

  • 2-4 years in agency-side experience in media buying or planning of US National TV/Video
  • Robust knowledge of US National TV/Video media strategy, investment principles, and techniques- inclusive of online and streaming services. Knowledge of other media types a plus
  • Possess analytical and written skills to explain data in a narrative format to drive client business forward
  • Ability to interpret and evaluate client media investments to ultimately provide relevant marketplace recommendations that improve performance and increase media value

We are a global fast-growing company which offers a variety of opportunities for you to develop your skill set and career. In exchange for your contribution, we can offer you:

Please, send us your CV in English

raw.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
raw.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Web Software Engineer III who will contribute to meaningful, real-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the business. In this role, you’ll build and scale experiences for hunters as part of the Hunt team. You’ll support onX's goal of delivering a best-in-class Hunt experience from onboarding through the season. You’ll take ownership of your work, collaborate closely with partners across the organization, and help move initiatives forward in an environment where priorities evolve, learning is celebrated, and you’re encouraged to keep stretching your skills. This role will report to an Engineering Manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Build, support, and evolve our web products for hunters using technologies like TypeScript, Vue, GraphQL (Apollo Client), and Mapbox
  • Own technical solutions from ideation through delivery, collaborating in decisions about architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
  • Partner with Product, Design, QA, and engineers across teams to deliver cohesive, high-quality customer experiences and navigate cross-team dependencies
  • Run and instrument A/B tests and feature rollouts using Split, Eppo, and Amplitude, to measure impact and make data-informed decisions
  • Raise the quality bar through design reviews, mentorship, and frontend best practices across teams
  • Monitor production health and participate in triaging and resolving incidents affecting web experiences
  • Write unit and end-to-end tests using Jest, Vitest, Cypress, and/or Playwright
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Four (4) or more years of professional software development experience is required, where at least two (2) years were focused on web client development
  • You have a strong foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and browser fundamentals
  • Experience with modern web frontend frameworks such as Vue, React, or Angular
  • Experience working with REST APIs and/or Apollo Client with GraphQL
  • Experience writing unit tests with Jest or Vitest
  • A strong sense of ownership and a get stuff done attitude
  • A willingness to collaborate, provide and receive mentorship, and advocacy for the customer experience
  • Willingness to flex across and contribute to platforms outside of Web, such as mobile clients or backend, when team priorities require it
  • A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel on occasion for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience with TypeScript and Vue
  • Familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling - e.g., Split/Eppo, client event instrumentation with Amplitude
  • Experience with Mapbox or other mapping tools
  • Experience across other platforms (mobile and backend)
  • Familiarity with caching using Apollo Client for GraphQL
  • Experience writing end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 - $153,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $5-$6.50/hour
performance-based increase after 6 months

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

  • Device Requirement: Mac OS required

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

description: 👋 About Boundless LifeBoundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth.

raw.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
raw.excerpt: 👋 About Boundless LifeBoundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth.
raw.description:
👋 About Boundless Life

Boundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth. We provide family-friendly accommodations, an innovative education system that travels with you, and vibrant communities of like-minded individuals. Our mission is to create immersive "live abroad" experiences that balance professional commitments with enriching personal development.

Since our founding in 2021, we've rapidly expanded to eight locations across Europe, Asia, and soon Latin America, bringing together over 140 team members from diverse backgrounds. Our growth reflects our commitment to transforming the experience economy and making a meaningful impact on how families integrate work, education, and exploration into their lives.At Boundless Life, we believe in the power of community and the importance of a holistic approach to education. Our programs are designed to inspire curiosity, build resilience, and nurture a global perspective, preparing children for an ever-changing future.

Join us in pioneering a new way of living that harmoniously blends work, learning, and adventure, enabling families to thrive in a connected and dynamic world.

🙌 The role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer at Boundless Life, your mission is to build the technology that powers a seamless experience for families living, learning and exploring the world.

You will play a key role in developing and scaling our digital ecosystem, from our admissions and booking platforms to our family community app and internal operational tools.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a product mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and cares deeply about the quality, reliability and maintainability of what they build.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into intuitive, scalable solutions that create real value for families and our teams.

A key part of the role will be balancing speed of delivery with engineering excellence — helping us move fast without compromising code quality, system reliability or long-term scalability.

We’re also looking for someone who embraces AI-powered development, modern engineering practices and continuous improvement to help us build smarter and more efficiently.

🎯 Key responsibilities will include:

1. Full Stack Product Development

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications across our customer-facing platforms and internal operational systems.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment and production monitoring.
  • Build intuitive, responsive and performant user interfaces that deliver a premium customer experience.
  • Develop reliable backend services, APIs, integrations and data models that support complex business workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to translate business requirements into practical, elegant technical solutions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify functionality, improve user experiences and reduce technical complexity.

2. Software Architecture & Engineering Excellence

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that ensure our technology remains scalable, secure and maintainable as Boundless grows.
  • Write clean, modular, well-tested and reusable code, following modern software engineering principles.
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt, duplicated logic, performance bottlenecks and fragile implementations.
  • Champion engineering best practices, including separation of concerns, automated testing, documentation and code reviews.
  • Design robust workflows that account for edge cases, failures, data consistency and transactional integrity.
  • Ensure critical business operations, particularly payments, bookings and customer data, are implemented with strong reliability and error-handling standards.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and challenge approaches that introduce unnecessary complexity or long-term maintenance risks.

3. Platform Reliability, Security & Performance

  • Take ownership of the stability, performance and reliability of the systems you develop.
  • Implement appropriate monitoring, logging and error-handling mechanisms to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.
  • Optimize database queries, API performance and application responsiveness.
  • Apply security best practices across authentication, authorization, data protection and third-party integrations.
  • Build resilient integrations with external services, including payment providers, communication platforms and other business-critical systems.
  • Ensure changes are deployed safely, with appropriate testing, rollback strategies and consideration for existing users and workflows.

4. AI-Powered Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing and code quality.
  • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to improve development workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when using AI-generated code, ensuring all implementations meet our quality, security and maintainability standards.
  • Contribute to improving development processes, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment practices.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend practical improvements that deliver measurable value.
  • Help establish an engineering culture that combines modern tooling, rapid experimentation and disciplined execution.

5. Technical Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product to understand the business context behind requirements and help shape effective technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions within your scope, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks and dependencies.
  • Provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews that improve quality and help other developers grow.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to raising engineering standards across the team.
  • Break down complex initiatives into manageable deliverables with realistic estimates and clear technical requirements.
  • Communicate progress, blockers and technical risks proactively.
  • Demonstrate accountability for outcomes, taking responsibility not just for delivering code but for ensuring it works reliably in production.

💥 What’s in it for you

  • The world is your oyster – immerse yourself in inspiring destinations while you work
  • Meaningful impact – create environments where children and families thrive together
  • Work-life integration – structured schedules with time to explore and recharge
  • The chance to build our IT function from the ground up, as our first dedicated hire in this space
  • Family benefits - Enjoy discounted tuition for your children at our Boundless Schools

    Take a look at our policies and benefits here

🚀 What we’re looking for

Technical experience

    • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience building and maintaining payment systems, e-commerce, CRM or booking systems
    • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Hotwire, React including modern frontend architecture, state management and performance optimization.
    • Strong backend development experience, ideally with Ruby on Rails and/or Node.js.
    • Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, indexing and transactional integrity.
    • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services.
    • Experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
    • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, automated testing and secure development practices.
    • Experience working with payment systems, complex transactional workflows or business-critical applications is a strong advantage.
    • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and integrating them into professional development workflows.

Mindset & ways of working

    • Ownership mentality: You take responsibility for the quality and reliability of your work, from initial design to production.
    • Product thinking: You care about the problems we’re solving and challenge requirements when there’s a better approach.
    • Engineering discipline: You understand that working software isn’t necessarily well-engineered software, and you know when to invest in doing things properly.
    • Pragmatism: You can balance technical perfection with business priorities, knowing when to move quickly and when to slow down.
    • Problem-solving: You investigate root causes, think through edge cases and anticipate potential failures before they happen.
    • Autonomy: You’re comfortable working independently, making decisions and navigating ambiguity without constant direction.
    • Collaboration: You communicate clearly, welcome feedback and enjoy helping others improve.
    • Continuous learning: You’re curious about emerging technologies, AI and better ways of building software.

✨ What's next?

  • First call with our Recruitment team (30 min)
  • Interview with our Head of Product & Infra (45 min)
  • Technical/scenario-based interview with Technical Lead (45 min)
  • Final check-in with our Design Lead (45 min)

The process might change slightly as we go along, we will keep you posted at all times.

Want to know more about working at Boundless Life? Check out our story!

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Are you passionate about Privacy Protections and the Open Web? Do you want to ship software to a large user base? Do you want your contributions to have a positive impact on the world? Do you want to advance current browser architecture to make the web a safer place for users?

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and restricted. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to support the Privacy Team to advance the Firefox Web Platform.

What you'll do:
  • Implement Privacy-improving, anti-tracking and threat intelligence protection into the Firefox web browser to mitigate user tracking and phishing.
  • Implement architectural improvements into Gecko, the browser engine underlying Firefox.
  • Build performant, low-latency, and maintainable C++, JavaScript and Rust code
  • Work as part of a geographically distributed team in an asynchronous manner (mostly Europe and US-East).
What you'll bring:
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related program; or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 4 years of experience with programming in C++ and Rust, with a strong background in memory safety, multi-threaded system architecture, or raw data stream manipulation.
  • Proven ability to onboard quickly, deliver and improve complex software projects.
  • Proven track record of independently scoping and landing complex features within tight release windows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can validate your progress and decisions and communicate them clearly.
Bonus Points:
  • You have already contributed to the Mozilla mission and the codebase.
  • Experience working within the browser space (Gecko, Chromium, WebKit) or web engine runtime abstractions.
  • Experience or high interest in designing or leveraging ML pipelines to automate internal developer workflows.
  • Deep understanding of web architecture, the privacy/security model of the web, and client-side data structures.
  • Knowledge of basic statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency with Python and SQL.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Title: Senior Account Executive

Reports To: SVP of Sales

Location: Saint John NB, or Remote (Canada)

Who We Are

Procedureflow is a growing B2B SaaS company helping organizations make complex work easier for both people and AI. We believe the future of work is human and AI working from the same trusted knowledge. Our platform helps organizations turn complex processes, policies, and procedures into clear, structured guidance that employees and AI agents can follow with confidence.

We’re a collaborative, curious, and customer-focused team building the knowledge foundation organizations need to support consistent execution today and AI-enabled work in the future.

What We Do

Procedureflow transforms complex organizational knowledge into clear, visual, and structured workflows that guide both human employees and AI agents through the right steps and decisions.

For employees, that means less time searching through documents, faster onboarding, fewer errors, and greater confidence when handling complex work. For AI, it provides access to approved, governed processes so agents can operate from the same trusted source of truth as the people they support. By connecting human and AI execution through one reliable knowledge foundation, Procedureflow helps organizations improve consistency, compliance, efficiency, and customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Full cycle Account Executive focusing on generating and closing new business by developing solutions that deliver real value for customer organizations
  • Lead generation, opportunity management, relationship development, with the objective of achieving revenue, client growth and client satisfaction targets
  • Creating Contracts, negotiating terms and conditions, and working relationships for client territories consistent with the guidelines of the product
  • Part of a highly passionate and engaged team, and contribute ideas and collaborate to meet the company’s targets

Who You Are

  • 3-5 years of sales experience selling SaaS offerings
  • University degree or relevant work experience equivalence
  • Proven success in achieving revenue targets and growing a start-up business
  • Knowledge and or/or experience selling to contact centres would be considered an asset
  • Experience with solution selling
  • Positive attitude with a professional approach
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and customer-facing)
  • Motivated to achieve sales targets; thrives on hunting for new business and closing deals
  • Great at connecting innovative business solutions to customer pains
  • Excel at finding and closing new business both over the phone, digitally and face to face
  • Ability to travel to industry events and to visit customers
  • Proficient in the use of AI solutions for go to market activities like prospect research, territory planning, outbound lead generation, sales strategy and customer presentations (experience with Claude, Copilot and ChatGPT would be an asset)
  • Adept at strengthening your approach and sales presentation to fit different clients or industries
  • Proficient with CRM (Salesforce would be an asset), ERP, and BPM tools
  • Application of sales methodology to manage sales cycles
  • Can create and evolve a social media or mass-market approach for generating leads and successfully work those opportunities
  • Articulates current industry trends/issues and leverages this information in discussions with customer
  • Consistently use sales tools and processes to create winning sales presentations

What We Offer

  • Benefits From Day One - and we cover the health & dental premiums
  • Paternal Leave Top-Up
  • Retirement Savings - employer matching up to 4%
  • Employee Stock Options
  • Home Office Equipment – laptop, monitor, mouse and keyboard are all included.

Remote Workspace Requirements

This is a remote role where you’ll work from your home office in a safe and ergonomic setup. You’ll need a reliable internet connection that can support video calls and online collaboration. The work primarily involves using a computer for extended periods, so having a comfortable workspace that supports focus and well-being is important.

Apply Now!

The ProcedureFlow team is highly skilled, motivated, hardworking, and fun! This position would be ideal for you if you are looking to be part of a fast-growing SaaS business. Have we piqued your interested? Awesome! Submit an application today and let’s connect.

While our many of our opportunities are remote positions, only those who are a Canadian citizen or a permanent resident of Canada with a valid Canadian work permit will be considered. All applications are appreciated, however, only those being considered for interviews will be acknowledged.

ProcedureFlow is an equitable and diverse employer; connect with us today!

About Us

NGP VAN is the winningest technology platform in the history of democratic and progressive causes, working tirelessly to innovate and advance the technology our clients rely on to bolster our democracy. We help power the trailblazers, campaigners, and advocates fighting up and down the ticket for equality, racial justice, reproductive freedom, democracy, climate reform, and more— including the national Democratic committees and progressive organizations, thousands of Democratic campaigns, hundreds of labor unions, advocacy organizations, progressive and non-partisan PACs, and other organizations.

About the Role

As a member of the State & Local Sales Team, you will sell NGP VAN's software products and technology services in a designated territory within the U.S. You will develop new business primarily through prospecting and cold calls, as well as by building relationships with Democratic officials, consultants, and members of the campaign professional community. You will conduct online demos, prepare written proposals, and negotiate and close sales. You will establish and grow relationships with current NGP VAN clients to identify opportunities to upsell additional tools and services.

Essential Position Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with a passionate and growing sales team to reach company revenue goals
  • Manage technology needed to track prospect outreach and client conversations
  • Collaborate with a wide array of NGP VAN staff to exceed each client's expectations
  • Rub elbows with Democratic activists, state stakeholders, fundraising consultants and members of the professional campaign community who are fighting the good fight
  • Join a great team that will readily share their wisdom on client management and digital outreach
  • Have a clear path for professional growth where great work is recognized and rewarded
  • Expand new business primarily through prospecting and cold outreach, as well as by building relationships with stakeholders, consultants, and campaign staff
  • Establish and grow relationships with current NGP VAN clients to encourage implementation of new innovative tools and services
  • Thrive in a fast-growing, start-up culture while balancing several tasks at once
  • Put your experience to work devising new and exciting ways we can serve our clients

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Demonstrated and passionate interest in Democratic political campaigns and progressive politics. We are particularly interested in candidates with significant digital experience, either in digital sales or as digital practitioners.
  • Former Democratic campaign managers, digital directors, finance staff, field organizers, and caucus directors with 1-3 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply
  • Meticulous attention to detail 
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • A passion for problem-solving, logistics, best practices, and data-driven decision-making
  • Comfort level with daily sales outreach: primarily via phone, online demonstrations, and email.
  • A keen interest in changing Democratic politics for the better -- and a nagging curiosity about how to use NGP VAN’s innovative tools to make that change happen
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; Salesforce and other CRM experience a big plus
  • Previous experience at with NGP VAN’s product suite or similar campaign CRMs

This position is a part of a bargaining union represented by CWA Local 1400, 2336, or 13000.

At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.


Our Culture

At NGP VAN, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.


Compensation & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being and growth - explore full details here.


Compensation and benefits for this U.S. role apply to regular full-time and part-time employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours a week. Pay reflects location, skills, experience, and education, and is one part of NGP VAN's total rewards package, which may include bonuses, incentives, and equity. Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer-subsidized premiums, unlimited Flexible Time Off (FTO), paid holidays, and dedicated time off to volunteer. Company Overview:

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Position Overview:

The Senior Project Consultant – Modern Work & Endpoint delivers Microsoft 365, Intune, and Purview projects for mid-market and enterprise clients in Arctiq's Microsoft practice. The role is hands-on and customer-facing: you assess the current state, write the design, get the customer's sign-off, and then build and hand over endpoint management, information protection, and Microsoft 365 workloads across cloud and hybrid environments.

You will be the practice's second deep resource on Intune and Purview, working alongside senior consultants who cover Active Directory, Exchange, and tenant migrations. Most engagements are delivered remotely, with occasional travel for kickoffs, critical milestones, or customer workshop

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the assessment and design phase of each engagement, produce the design document, and obtain customer sign-off before build or cutover
  • Design and implement Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot: enrollment, configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, update rings, and migration from Group Policy or Configuration Manager
  • Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, and retention, and prepare tenants for Microsoft 365 Copilot (oversharing and access review, licensing prerequisites, pilot design)
  • Configure the Microsoft 365 security baseline: Entra ID Conditional Access and MFA, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, and Secure Score improvements
  • Deliver projects to the approved Statement of Work; identify scope changes early and support the change-order process with the Project Manager
  • Estimate level of effort and review proposed scope for Modern Work opportunities so that what Arctiq sells is what it can deliver
  • Produce assessment reports, designs, runbooks, and as-built documentation the customer can operate from; mentor other consultants on endpoint management and Purview
  • Report status to the Project Manager and practice leadership; enter time, expenses, and project activities accurately and on time

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years delivering Microsoft 365 and endpoint management solutions, including 3+ years in a consulting or professional-services role
  • At least one current certification: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401), or Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102)
  • Led an Intune and Autopilot deployment of 500+ devices, including at least one Group Policy or Configuration Manager to Intune migration
  • Implemented Microsoft Purview (labels, DLP, retention) for a regulated or multi-entity customer
  • Rolled out Entra ID Conditional Access and MFA in production tenants, including hybrid-joined devices
  • Microsoft 365 licensing knowledge (E3, E5, F1 and F3, Business plans, add-ons) and experience with license reviews or renewal planning
  • PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for tenant and endpoint administration
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; design documents that customers signed off on

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure fundamentals applied to Microsoft 365 and endpoint work: virtual networks, VPN and ExpressRoute connectivity, network security groups, and Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365 (AZ-104, AZ-700, or AZ-140)
  • macOS, iOS, and Android management in Intune, including Apple Business Manager
  • Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot pilots or readiness assessments, and Microsoft Copilot or AI credentials
  • SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator or SC-100 Cybersecurity Architect
  • Experience in a Microsoft partner, Microsoft Consulting Services, or FastTrack delivery role

Niyam is seeking a Principal Engineer, GIS / Geospatial Solutions to serve as the company's senior-most hands-on technical authority for geospatial engineering. This individual will define technical strategy and reference architecture for our GIS solution accelerators (GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ), serve as lead Solution Architect on GIS-focused proposals and captures, and represent Niyam externally as a recognized geospatial thought leader through technical publications and conference speaking. The role combines deep hands-on delivery across active federal contracts with enterprise-level influence on Niyam's geospatial technical direction and growth strategy, and requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance to support Niyam's continued expansion into DoD and Intelligence Community work.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Strategy
    • Serve as the company-wide expert and recognized thought leader in GIS/geospatial engineering, setting technical direction for GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ, and related capabilities.
    • Define technical strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards for geospatial data ingestion, the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture, and the Model Lifecycle Management Framework.
    • Solve the organization's most complex or ambiguous geospatial and spatial-analytics challenges, from data fusion and geoprocessing to real-time situational awareness dashboards.
    • Collaborate closely with Niyam's Technical Directors (GIS, Solutions Engineering, Data Analytics) to align geospatial strategy with enterprise technical direction.
    • Drive innovation, such as AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics and predictive risk modeling, that materially improves platform capability, performance, or revenue.
    Solution Architecture & Delivery
    • Serve as the primary Solution Architect on GIS-related engagements, providing hands-on architecture and delivery leadership across multiple active contracts/projects concurrently.
    • Design and oversee geodatabase architecture, geoprocessing models, and cloud-native geospatial pipelines that meet performance, security, and scalability requirements.
    • Resolve high-impact technical risks and escalations across GIS programs, ensuring solutions align with client mission needs and Niyam engineering standards.
    • Directly influence revenue and CPAR/customer-satisfaction performance by shaping technical strategy and solution quality across multiple projects.
    Business Development & Proposal Leadership
    • Act as lead Solution Architect and technical author on GIS-focused proposals and capture efforts, defining win themes, technical differentiators, and solution strategy.
    • Advise capture leadership and executives on technical feasibility, innovation opportunities, and competitive positioning for geospatial pursuits.
    • Support orals preparation, client technical due diligence, and solution demonstrations as the geospatial subject matter expert.
    • Partner with the GIS Technical Director and capture teams to protect and grow revenue through differentiated, credible geospatial solution offerings.
    Thought Leadership & External Representation
    • Author and publish technical blog posts, white papers, and case studies that position Niyam IT as an innovator in geospatial intelligence and disaster/risk analytics.
    • Speak at industry conferences, client forums, and technical webinars as a recognized geospatial subject matter expert, building Niyam's brand and pipeline visibility.
    • Represent Niyam in professional GIS/geospatial communities (e.g., Esri User Conferences, GEOINT, FedGeoDay) to strengthen market positioning and teaming relationships.
    Mentorship & Organizational Growth
    • Mentor engineers at all levels (Associate Engineer through Staff Engineer/Lead Architect) on geospatial engineering practices and career growth.
    • Make substantial contributions to the GIS/Geospatial Center of Competency (CoC), including standards, training materials, and reusable technical assets.
    • Support hiring and technical interviews for geospatial roles across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Geospatial Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree).
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in GIS/geospatial engineering, including architecture-level design of geospatial platforms and analytics solutions.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with the Esri ArcGIS platform (ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro), geodatabase design, and geoprocessing model development.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting cloud-native, scalable geospatial data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) including data pipelines and API-enabled analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or other languages used for geospatial data engineering, automation, and analytics.
  • Proven track record leading technical proposal content, solution architecture, and capture support for federal government contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and driving technical standards across teams or programs.
  • One or more industry-recognized certifications of considerable difficulty in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Esri Technical Certification, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, GISP).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience authoring technical publications and presenting to technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Active Top Secret clearance or prior DoD/Intelligence Community clearance eligibility.
  • Experience with hazard risk modeling, emergency management, or disaster response platforms (e.g., FEMA, DHS, or similar mission areas).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics, predictive modeling, or the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture pattern.
  • Prior publication of technical white papers, blog content, or peer-reviewed papers, and experience speaking at industry conferences (e.g., Esri UC, GEOINT Symposium, FedGeoDay).
  • Experience supporting GSA MAS, OASIS+, or other federal contract vehicle proposal efforts.

Why Join Niyam
