raw.excerpt: Cross-industry, insurance-first | Global remit | Americas-based, remote | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer Who we areAdlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries.
raw.description:
Cross-industry, insurance-first | Global remit | Americas-based, remote | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer

Who we are

Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.

On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply the customer’s rules, route the exception and trigger the next action. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it.

For insurance carriers that means agentic intake across FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions and endorsements. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design, sitting in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco rather than replacing any of it. We serve life sciences, insurance and public sector customers, and we are backed by Diversis Capital.

The role

This is not a standard VP of Sales job. Insurance is our core growth driver and this role goes deepest there, but it carries the whole company number across life sciences, public sector and OEM as well, worldwide. It also has to absorb sellers and systems from an acquisition, and leave the sales function in a state that stands up to institutional scrutiny.

You will inherit a small, capable team and an open field. We are blending a startup mentality with an established business, so you can innovate faster while deploying proven sales tactics and processes that work. You are building the machine: territory and quota design, capacity planning, methodology, deal inspection, and a forecast the Board can rely on. You report to the Chief Commercial Officer and sit on the commercial leadership team.

You will also sell. At our current team size this is a working leadership role, and you will personally lead the largest opportunities in your first two quarters.

The details

Role

Vice President of Sales

Reports to

Chief Commercial Officer

Scope

All new ARR worldwide, cross-industry, with an insurance-first focus

Team

Matrixed leadership with line-of-business General Managers (GMs) of the quota-carrying sales team, scaling with the plan

Location

Remote, based in the Americas. Global remit, with travel of approximately 30%.

Base salary

$175,000 to $200,000 USD

On-target earnings

$350,000 to $400,000 USD (50/50 base and variable, with accelerators above plan)

Equity

Participation in the management incentive plan, with change-of-control treatment

What you will own

  • The number. Carry and deliver the company new ARR number worldwide, across all industries, direct and partner-influenced. You are based in the Americas and the remit is global, including EMEA.
  • Team build. Recruit, ramp and coach the quota-carrying team. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time on hiring. The team you build in your first six months is what shows up in bookings in your second year.
  • Capacity and quota. Own territory design, quota assignment, and the sales capacity model. Quota is derived from rep productivity and carries deliberate over-assignment, not calculated backwards from the target.
  • Forecast integrity. Own a weekly forecast with defined stage exit criteria and conversion rates derived from actual closed-deal history. Forecast means high confidence, not hope.
  • Insurance leadership. Go deepest in insurance. Own the executive relationships at target carriers, MGAs, TPAs and brokers, and make sure our claims and underwriting story lands with operators, not just IT.

  • Hold the differentiation line. Our biggest competitive risk is being boxed as another OCR or IDP tool by buyers who have been pitched by every extraction vendor and are now hearing agentic AI from their core platform vendor as well.
  • Acquisition integration. Bring the acquired selling team onto one CRM, one pipeline, one forecast and one comp philosophy. Retain the sellers worth retaining, resolve account conflict, and deliver the cross-sell the acquisition was underwritten on.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Partner with the Industry General Managers on vertical strategy and named accounts, with Marketing on pipeline coverage, with Strategic Partnerships on partner-sourced opportunities, and with Revenue Operations on quota, comp mechanics and reporting.
  • Institutional readiness. Keep the sales function audit-ready. Cohort retention, quota attainment distribution, pipeline quality, win-loss, sales cycle by segment and forecast accuracy history should be current at all times, not reconstructed under deadline.

What you bring

  • Scale experience. You have taken B2B software businesses from $2M to $50M or more in ARR in a sales leadership seat. You can speak precisely to ARR, seller count and per-rep productivity at the start and the end.
  • Insurance depth. You have sold into insurance carriers, MGAs, TPAs, brokers or reinsurers and can hold a conversation with a Chief Claims Officer or Chief Underwriting Officer on their terms. You understand the claims and submission lifecycle, loss ratio and expense ratio, cycle time, leakage and straight-through processing. You know your way around Guidewire, Duck Creek and the wider core and content stack, and around ACORD and ISO forms, NAIC and state DOI expectations.
  • Cross-industry range. You have carried a number across two or more unrelated verticals at the same time. You know how to keep a small team focused without letting one vertical starve the others.
  • Global remit. You have led sellers or carried a number across more than one region, including Europe. You know how deal cycles, buying norms and employment practice differ outside North America, and you can run a team you do not sit beside.
  • A team you built. You have personally recruited and ramped five to eight quota carriers. You can name them and say where they are now.
  • Operating rigor. You build quota from steady-state rep productivity, plan for ramp, and can explain your capacity model on a whiteboard. You track attainment as a distribution, not an average.
  • Acquisition integration. You have merged two selling teams after an acquisition. You have made the single versus dual go-to-market call, harmonized comp and territories without losing the people who mattered, and consolidated onto one pipeline.
  • Exit experience. You have owned the sales side of a sale process or major diligence. You know what a buyer or banker asks the sales organization for, and what breaks when the data does not hold up.
  • Enterprise and regulated selling. You are credible on AI without overselling it. You sell business outcomes and defensible data, not model hype.
  • A working leader. You are still close enough to the work to run a deal yourself, and you want to be. You take coaching as readily as you give it.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a private equity backed company with a defined growth mandate and reporting cadence.
  • Relationships in the insurance systems integrator ecosystem, including Guidewire and Duck Creek implementation partners.
  • Experience selling AI, intelligent document processing or data platform solutions into regulated industries.
  • Life sciences or public sector selling experience alongside insurance.
  • Experience selling in Canada and Latin America as well as the United States.

What is in it for you

This is a rare shape of role: enough scale that the fundamentals exist, enough whitespace that you will build most of what matters, and a clear horizon to build toward. You will have direct access to the CEO and the Board, and your work will be visible in every conversation about the company’s value.

Adlib’s headquarters are in Burlington, Ontario. This role is remote and based in the Americas, with a global remit. We care about employee health and wellness and build programs around personal and professional satisfaction. Our employee programs and benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Wellness and lifestyle spending account
  • RRSP or 401(k) matching
  • No limit vacation
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee assistance programs, and much more

To learn more about this role, please express your interest here, or follow us on LinkedIn for future opportunities.

Adlib seeks to inspire and nurture the human spirit. We understand that each person brings a distinct life experience to the table. Embracing diversity not only enhances our work culture, it drives business success. Adlib encourages applications from everybody, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Salary: $175,000-200,000 USD Annually + Commission

raw.title: Instructional Designer- Partner Specific
raw.excerpt: This position is not open to applicants residing in or otherwise based in California, New York, Illinois, or Massachusetts.
raw.description:
This position is not open to applicants residing in or otherwise based in California, New York, Illinois, or Massachusetts. Additionally, applicants must be located in the Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones.

Note to Applicants

We’re looking for professionals who take pride in their work. We know your resume tells part of the story, but our application questions help us understand how you think and work. Because we receive a high volume of applications, only applications with complete, thoughtful responses will be reviewed.

Given the AI restriction on this engagement, described below, we ask that your responses be your own work.

Engagement Details

This is instructional design work, with a twist.

Every project starts with an existing course and a charter that defines exactly what is changing about it. The work is reading that charter closely, translating it into specific revisions in specific places, and executing them cleanly on a short, fixed cycle, without drifting into the parts of the course the charter does not cover.

It calls on the full instructional design skill set: learning theory, alignment, assessment design, accessibility, and SME collaboration. What is distinctive is where the difficulty sits. The hard calls here are about scope and defensibility: deciding what a charter line means in practice, and documenting why you drew the line where you did. It also means finding things you would want to change and leaving them alone. If your instinct when you open a course is to fix everything you find, this engagement will frustrate you. If you can see all of it and still deliver only what the charter covers, documenting the rest for the partner, you should do well here.

You will work with Subject Matter Experts and coordinate with internal teams, including Editorial and Quality Review, ensuring every revision adheres to research-based practice and partner-defined quality standards.

This engagement carries a partner data restriction. No partner course content, materials, or partner-provided information may be entered into, uploaded to, or processed by any AI system, internal or external, at any point during the engagement.

This is an independent contractor engagement (1099). Contractors are free to work with other clients, and accepting one project carries no obligation to accept another. Meeting times are set in advance around each project’s milestones. Outside of those scheduled meetings and agreed deadlines, you determine your own working hours and process for completing the work.

Scope of Work

  • Complete a scoped review of the assigned course and map the charter to specific course locations, documenting cascading effects, assumptions, and ambiguities before development begins.
  • Deliver a specific list of items requiring SME input before the first working session.
  • Collaborate with SMEs to revise instruction and assessments in scope, aligned to learning outcomes and the charter, while documenting anything outside scope rather than addressing it.
  • Suggest relevant open educational resources and instructional methods appropriate to the revision.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of design decisions to support partner review and approval.
  • Incorporate partner and stakeholder feedback through agreed revision cycles.
  • Facilitate SME working sessions to obtain the approvals required to complete deliverables.
  • Coordinate with internal teams at defined handoff points to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Complete self-QA before each handoff and deliver complete, accurate work by each fixed milestone.
  • Submit a status update with each milestone deliverable, and flag anything that's off track as soon as you identify it, so downstream stakeholders aren't caught by surprise.
  • Work from the version of the design standards and charter in effect for your project. Both may be revised between projects as the program evolves.

What You Need to Get the Job Done

  • Advanced degree in Education, Instructional Technology, or a related field.
  • Current, in-depth knowledge of instructional design and learning theories, with expertise in online learning, instructional design and technology, adult learning theory, and andragogy/pedagogy.
  • Demonstrated experience (3-5 years) collaborating with SMEs on online course development in higher education or corporate environments.
  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships with SMEs while moving projects forward and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead and influence collaboratively, including holding a scope boundary professionally.
  • Ability to read a scope document and identify not just what it says, but what it means in practice: what it touches, what it doesn’t, and what’s ambiguous.
  • Strong independent judgment: the ability to make a clean, documented, defensible decision on an ambiguous question without needing every call reviewed.
  • Experience with ADA compliance and quality standards for course design (e.g., Quality Matters, OLC).
  • Competency navigating various LMS systems such as Brightspace, D2L, Canvas, Moodle, etc.
  • Ability to recognize AI-generated material in SME submissions and evaluate it critically against design standards and learning objectives.
  • Ability to pick up a revised standard or specification between projects and apply it accurately, without a ramp-up period.
  • Strong organizational skills, excellent follow-through, and exceptional attention to detail.

Is This Engagement Right for You?

  • Trust that addressing what’s in scope serves the student better than expanding into what isn’t.
  • Naturally front-load your prep, arriving at meetings with a plan rather than still forming one.
  • Can hold a professional boundary on scope with a SME without straining the relationship.
  • Comfortable working without AI assistance on partner content.
  • Deliver complete, accurate work on a hard deadline, consistently.
  • Communicate proactively, especially when something is going wrong.
  • Pick up a revised standard between projects and apply it, without defaulting back to the previous version.

What Will Make Us REALLY Love You

  • A proven track record of working with academic and business partners to create engaging and effective online courses.
  • Excellent oral/written communication and presentation skills.
  • Background in Learner Experience Design.
  • Expertise in competency-based learning.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of available open educational resources (OERs).
  • Quality assurance training and certification (QM, OSCQR, other).
  • Post-secondary teaching and learning experience.

iDesign is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment in which everyone is a valued member. At iDesign, all hiring decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We seek applicants of diverse backgrounds and hire without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To help us get to know you beyond your resume, please answer the application questions fully. Incomplete responses will not be reviewed.

Join GDIT to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) through the IOSS App Hosting program.


HOW A CONTAINER PLATFORM LEAD WILL MAKE AN IMPACT


As the Container Platform Lead, you will oversee enterprise container hosting operations across Kubernetes environments in Azure, AWS, and on‑prem OpenShift—ensuring 99.9% uptime, secure configurations, automated deployment reliability, and consistent DevSecOps practices.


You will provide governance and performance oversight for control planes, worker nodes, GitOps pipelines, policy enforcement, cluster lifecycle operations, and vulnerability remediation. You will manage platform performance measurement systems, coordinate testing cycles, validate SLAs, maintain dashboards and reporting packages, and embed DevSecOps requirements into all container lifecycle processes. You will streamline deployment workflows, improve automation pipelines, enhance configuration consistency, and ensure container operations remain aligned, efficient, and compliant.


You will partner directly with VA leadership and service line managers to provide operational reviews, modernization roadmaps, incident analyses, and improvement recommendations. Your communication ensures transparency, alignment, and stakeholder confidence across the platform.

You will drive continuous improvement by identifying modernization opportunities, resolving configuration and deployment gaps, optimizing automation, refining SOPs, strengthening governance controls, and maturing enterprise performance and security practices. Your leadership ensures VA’s container hosting environment remains resilient, scalable, secure, and continuously advancing.

    • Familiarity with container security requirements, vulnerability management, DevSecOps frameworks, and cloud governance practices

raw.title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
raw.excerpt: About TelnyxTelnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it.
raw.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue.

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer.

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Our Team

The Content Experience Innovation (CEI) product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. We sit at the intersection of Product, Tech, Content, and Production, and act as the connective tissue that keeps our product surface in step with our content strategy.


This role sits on the Configurations team within Content Experience Innovation (CEI), connecting CEI with the broader business through configurable, high-velocity capabilities that scale globally and for every content type. We are looking for a Senior Product Operations Lead/Program Manager to join our team.


The Role

You’ll own the product operations backbone of the team including the ways of working, operating rhythms, portfolio visibility, and systems that make a fast-moving product organization more efficient and effective. You’ll also be responsible for aligning those operating rhythms to those of our partner teams across Product + Tech, working in lock step with the Prod Ops partners Member Experience and Commerce product orgs to ensure we all work together toward a cohesive end member experience. You’ll also flex into Program Management to drive critical innovation programs across the team to bring our product vision to life.

  • Strengthen how the team works by defining, documenting, and maintaining the ways of working and standards that keep product development running smoothly.
  • Run the team's core operating cadences, including planning, OKRs, and QBRs while coordinating inputs, timelines, and deliverables, and turning them into clear, actionable and decision-ready readouts for leadership.
  • Own portfolio-level operations: manage intake and prioritization, maintain the roadmap and launch calendar, and give the team and its partners a clear view of what's in flight, what's coming, and what's at risk.
  • Drive stakeholder communication and alignment by keeping partners across Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams informed of key dates, changes, and dependencies, and maintain a single, trusted source of truth for plans, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Design and build scalable systems, workflows, and tooling that reduce manual effort and make the team faster, leveraging AI and automation where it creates efficiency.
  • Identify operational opportunity areas across the product development lifecycle, and drive improvements that increase quality, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Partner with New Content Exploration and various Product and Tech teams on initiatives within their innovation roadmaps.
  • Lead complex programs that cut across product areas that transform the way we work, managing high degrees of change.
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape the business vision and opportunity of transformation efforts.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of Product Operations, Product or Program Management, Business Operations, or related experience in a product-driven organization.
  • A track record of designing and scaling operational processes, rhythms, and systems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Fluency with operating cadences such as planning, OKRs, and QBRs, and the ability to turn messy inputs into clean, decision-ready outputs.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to connect the dots between projects and programs to ladder up to company and team goals
  • Demonstrated ability to build tooling and workflows that create leverage, including practical use of AI and automation to improve efficiency.
  • A sharp eye for operational opportunity areas across a product development lifecycle, and the judgment to prioritize the improvements that matter most.
  • Strong cross-functional partnering skills across Product, Engineering, TPM, Design, and non-technical teams.
  • Fluency with product/ops tooling (e.g., Jira, Airtable) and comfort adapting shared frameworks to what a team actually needs.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, including clear updates for leadership.
  • Content discovery, merchandising performance management, or recommendation systems domain experience preferred.

Title: Commercial Sales Account Manager

Location/Set-Up: Remote, with regular travel to key customers, partners, and events. Preferably based near a regional airport for convenient access to travel.

About the role:

The Commercial Sales Account Manager owns a portfolio of existing customer accounts and is measured on retention and expansion rather than new logo acquisition. You will serve as the trusted, day-to-day point of contact for your accounts, understanding their business, anticipating their needs, and using data and customer trends to help them succeed. In this role you are supported by PSB's Sales Operations team in Manila, who partner with you on reporting and dashboards, CRM hygiene, order and quote support, and account analytics for you to spend the majority of your time in front of customers. Success in this role comes from consistent, relationship-driven engagement, proactive problem-solving, and a genuine commitment to customer outcomes.

Your primary objective in your role is to increase net revenue retention by preventing customer churn and growing our business with existing customers. This role is focused on nurturing and expanding established accounts, deepening relationships, uncovering new opportunities within the current customer base, and ensuring every customer sees ongoing value in partnering with Pioneer Square Brands.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own retention & growth: Manage and grow a portfolio of existing customer accounts, with a primary focus on net revenue retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion
  • Prevent churn: Proactively identify at-risk accounts, understand the drivers of churn, and lead recovery and retention efforts before customers disengage
  • Grow existing business: Uncover upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts by understanding each customer’s evolving needs and aligning them to PSB products and solutions
  • Introduce new and updated products to existing customers, and uncover potential for custom product opportunities
  • Be the trusted partner: Serve as the primary point of contact, building strong, trusted relationships across multiple stakeholders and ensuring a consistently positive customer experience
  • Use data to advise: Analyze customer purchasing patterns, usage data, and market trends to deliver insights, tailored recommendations, and data-backed business reviews
  • Show up in person: Travel approximately 40% of the time to visit customer sites and represent PSB at trade shows and industry events
  • Keep the data clean: Maintain accurate account records, forecasts, and activity in the CRM, and report on retention, expansion, and pipeline health
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Marketing, Product, Customer Support, and Operations to resolve issues quickly and deliver on customer commitments

Job Qualifications:

  • At least 2–5 years in a comparable account management or customer-facing sales role
  • Energized by nurturing and expanding existing relationships rather than chasing brand-new logos
  • Comfortable with up to 40% travel to customer sites and trade shows
  • Enjoys digging into data, understanding customer trends, and genuinely helping customers succeed
  • Calm, steady, and able to build authentic connections and trust with a wide range of stakeholders
  • Ability to be the customer's advocate in chief at VAULT, connecting them to the resources internally that they need to succeed
  • Experience selling into commercial, B2B, or channel accounts, ideally with physical or consumer hardware products
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce or HubSpot) and comfort working with sales data and reporting tools
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding retention, renewal, or expansion targets

Skills & Competencies:

  • Relationship Building
  • Customer-Centric Mindset
  • Account Growth & Retention
  • Data-Driven Insight
  • Communication & Influence
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Resilience & Adaptability
  • Technical Aptitude

Success Factors:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) - Meets or exceeds NRR targets across the assigned account portfolio
  • Churn Prevention - Reduces avoidable churn; at-risk accounts are identified and recovered early
  • Account Expansion - Grows revenue within existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell
  • Customer Health - High customer satisfaction, retention, and reference-ability
  • Engagement Rhythm - Consistent business reviews, site visits, and proactive touchpoints

Executive Assistant (Assistant to Executive Director)

The Leadership School (Remote position)

Position Summary

The Executive Administrative Assistant serves as a trusted partner to the Executive Director, Governing Board Members, and leadership team by providing high-level administrative, operational, financial, governance, and compliance support. This position is responsible for managing critical organizational systems, maintaining records, coordinating reporting requirements, supporting grant administration, and ensuring the efficient flow of information across the school.

Executive Director Administrative Support

  • Provides comprehensive administrative support to the Executive Director.
  • Manages and maintains the Executive Director's calendar to ensure it remains current, transparent, organized, and aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Assists in prioritizing and tracking Executive Director action items through the school's Governing Board Task Management Tracker.
  • Maintains organization of the Executive Director's email and correspondence to ensure timely follow-up and efficient communication.
  • Assists with the preparation of Governing Board presentations, reports, PowerPoint presentations, annual reports, and quarterly/monthly updates to the school community and Governing Board Members.
  • Coordinates meetings, prepares agendas, compiles supporting materials, and tracks follow-up actions.

Governing Board Support

  • Supports the Governing Board and its committees by maintaining governance records and ensuring timely filing of required documents.
  • Uploads and maintains Governing Board agendas, meeting packets, approved minutes, financial disclosure acknowledgements, and related governance documents in ReportWell and other required platforms.
  • Coordinates the posting and filing of quarterly financial reports and other required governance documents on Board management platforms and public portals.
  • Assists with information gathering, data compilation, and preparation of Governing Board reports and presentations.
  • Maintains accurate governance records in accordance with Missouri public charter school requirements, Sunshine Law requirements, and school policies.

Grant Management & Compliance

  • Supports administration of grants, including Charter Schools Program (CSP) grants and other funding sources.
  • Tracks staff time and effort documentation via task sheets, and reimbursement records as required by grant guidelines.
  • Compiles and submits reimbursement requests and supporting documentation for grant-funded expenditures.
  • Maintains organized grant records and supporting documentation to ensure compliance with funding requirements and audit standards.
  • Assists leadership with monitoring grant timelines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations.

Finance & Audit Support

  • Collects, organizes, and maintains monthly financial documentation, including receipts, invoices, credit card reconciliations, and supporting records required by the school's financial service providers.
  • Coordinates with EdOps and other financial partners to ensure timely submission of documentation and efficient processing of financial transactions.
  • Assists in maintaining records necessary for annual financial audits and organizational reviews.
  • Supports the preparation and organization of documentation requested by auditors, including Marr & Company and other financial consultants.
  • Maintains confidential financial records and documentation in accordance with school policies.

Operations & Records Management

  • Maintains the school's operational file management systems, including the TLS Operations Google Drive structure and electronic records, ensuring documents are complete, organized, and easily accessible.
  • Develops and maintains filing systems that support efficient retrieval of records for staff, auditors, authorizers, Governing Board Members, and other stakeholders.
  • Assists the Director of Operations with gathering and organizing information necessary to meet reporting deadlines and compliance requirements.
  • Supports the preparation, compilation, and submission of organizational reports through ReportWell and other required reporting platforms.
  • Maintains highly confidential student, personnel, financial, and organizational records.

Key Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible administrative support experience required.
  • Experience in a public charter school, school district, nonprofit organization, government agency, or similarly regulated environment preferred.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership, governing boards, grants management, financial documentation, compliance activities, and organizational operations strongly preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and presentation software.
  • Experience with ReportWell, Board management platforms, document management systems, and financial recordkeeping tools preferred.
  • Strong data management, reporting, and organizational skills.

Professional Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
  • Commitment to professionalism, accountability, transparency, and supporting the mission of the school.

Starting Salary: $40,000 - $55,000

Travel may be required 2-3 times/year

À propos de Nestify

Nestify est une société internationale de gestion immobilière bien établie, présente au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Irlande et aux Émirats arabes unis. L'entreprise est détenue, dirigée et gérée par des personnes passionnées, entourées d'une équipe d'experts hautement qualifiés. Nestify s'appuie sur des talents recrutés dans le monde entier, qui contribuent directement à la réussite de l'entreprise.

Nestify est le partenaire de gestion locative Airbnb privilégié de nombreux propriétaires internationaux, à qui elle permet d'obtenir des revenus locatifs plus élevés pour des séjours de courte, moyenne et longue durée. En tant qu'entreprise tournée vers la technologie, Nestify propose un service sans contact disponible 24h/24 et 7j/7, afin que les clients du monde entier profitent du séjour qu'ils méritent. De la réservation au départ, en passant par le ménage et la maintenance, Nestify s'occupe de tout et garantit une expérience fluide à l'ensemble de ses clients et voyageurs.

À propos du poste

Le Senior Sales Executive 360° (Acquisition de biens) est responsable de la croissance du portefeuille de biens et prend en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos marchés cibles. Dans ce rôle, vous prospectez de nouveaux leads, convertissez les demandes entrantes de propriétaires, réactivez les opportunités dormantes du pipeline et développez des réseaux stratégiques de recommandation B2B au niveau local.

Même si vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe solidaire, ce poste exige un profil de closer autonome, qui aime assumer l'entière responsabilité de son pipeline. Vous devez être à l'aise dans les conversations difficiles à fort enjeu et savoir lever des objections complexes pour conclure des contrats.

Le Senior Sales Executive 360° rend compte au Sales Manager et joue un rôle clé dans l'accélération du chiffre d'affaires et du portefeuille de biens de Nestify.

Missions et responsabilités

  • Gestion complète du cycle de vente : piloter l'ensemble du cycle de vente à 360°, de la prospection et des appels de découverte jusqu'à l'émission et la signature des contrats.
  • Conversion des leads entrants : présenter l'offre, négocier et conclure avec les propriétaires dont les rendez-vous ont été générés par le site web et l'équipe SDR.
  • Prospection proactive et réactivation : mener des actions de prospection à froid et à chaud pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités et relancer les comptes non convertis ou inactifs.
  • Développement de partenariats B2B : identifier et contacter des agents immobiliers, gestionnaires de biens, promoteurs et conseillers financiers locaux, et construire avec eux des relations directes de recommandation.
  • Traitement des objections et négociation : mener avec assurance des échanges complexes à fort enjeu et lever les objections des clients tout en maintenant la dynamique de la vente, afin d'atteindre des taux de closing élevés.
  • Gestion du CRM et du pipeline : tenir un CRM rigoureusement à jour, en suivant l'ensemble des actions de prospection, le statut des contrats, les étapes du pipeline et les indicateurs de conversion.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en vente sur l'ensemble du cycle, en B2B direct ou en vente de services en mode conseil.
  • Capacité démontrée à conclure des contrats par téléphone ou à distance et à mener seul(e) des négociations difficiles à fort enjeu.
  • Forte discipline en prospection sortante et volonté de s'impliquer concrètement dans la prospection à froid.
  • Grande agilité culturelle, avec une expérience de la vente auprès de clients français ou internationaux, ou du travail avec eux.
  • Excellent niveau de français oral, de niveau professionnel (B2/C1 minimum).
  • Très organisé(e), résilient(e) et motivé(e), capable d'atteindre ses objectifs avec un encadrement minimal.
  • Une expérience dans l'immobilier, la gestion de biens ou la location courte durée est un plus, mais n'est pas obligatoire.

Jours et horaires de travail

  • Du lundi au vendredi
  • De 9h00 à 18h00 (heure de Paris)
  • Lieu : télétravail
  • Temps plein

Ce que Nestify vous offre

  • Un salaire fixe compétitif, complété par un système de commissions attractif basé sur la performance.
  • L'opportunité de travailler au sein d'une équipe internationale motivée et talentueuse.
  • Des congés généreux.
  • Une culture d'entreprise qui valorise la loyauté, le travail, l'engagement, la performance et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.
  • Un environnement autonome offrant de réelles perspectives d'évolution.

raw.description:
*** EventMobi is an all-remote company and this is a fully remote position, open to all candidates with a focus in Pakistan, India, Brazil, Columbia, Argentina and Mexico.

You will need to be able to work in EST time zones. ***

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

At EventMobi, you won’t just build UI components. You’ll help deliver meaningful product experiences used by thousands of organizations around the world.

Our front-end applications are large-scale React/TypeScript systems with real-world complexity: offline capabilities, cross-device support, and performance-sensitive rendering. You’ll work on features that directly impact users, while developing a deeper understanding of how modern front-end systems are designed and evolve over time.

This role is ideal for engineers who are strong in fundamentals, take pride in their craft, and want to grow into more advanced system design and ownership over time.
We believe great engineers take ownership of their work, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. You’ll be supported by experienced teammates while having the autonomy to contribute meaningfully from day one.

We also believe the next generation of engineers will be AI-native. You’ll be encouraged to use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, code quality, and learning speed.

HEAR FROM OUR FRONT-END ENGINEER, MOEED:

“I’ve been here a little over 2 years, working across the front end, mostly focused on onsite and registration flows. What I have enjoyed the most here is a mix of real ownership and strong support. You’re trusted to lead meaningful work, but there’s always someone ready to jump in and debug or brainstorm with you.

There’s also never a shortage of genuinely interesting technical challenges, which keep things fun and help you grow. The team is very collaborative and product‑minded, and being here has pushed me to think beyond ‘just code’ to how what I build actually impacts customers and the business.”

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON:

This role sits at the intersection of hands-on development, product thinking, and continuous growth.

Build Modern Web Experiences

  • Develop responsive, high-quality interfaces using React & JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Contribute to features within our Progressive Web App
  • Help deliver reliable experiences across devices and varying network conditions

Contribute to Feature Development

  • Implement features from defined requirements and collaborate on design decisions
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and senior engineers
  • Balance user experience, performance, and technical constraints

Work Within Scalable Front-End Systems

  • Contribute to a shared codebase with established patterns and practices
  • Participate in discussions around architecture and system improvements
  • Learn how to navigate and improve large, evolving applications

Collaborate and Improve as a Team

  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
  • Apply feedback to continuously improve code quality and approach
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, clarity, and shared ownership

Work Smarter with AI

  • Use AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude, Codex) to accelerate development
  • Improve productivity in debugging, testing, and implementation tasks
  • Continuously refine how you integrate AI into your workflow

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

You’re a solid engineer with strong fundamentals and a desire to grow.

  • 3–5 years of experience building user-facing web applications
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React
  • Strong understanding of modern HTML, CSS, and front-end fundamentals
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating backend services
  • Ability to debug issues and work within existing codebases
  • Familiarity with testing (unit and end-to-end)
  • Clear written communication skills (we’re async-first)

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with state management or data-fetching libraries (e.g., React Query)
  • Exposure to performance optimization or scalable front-end patterns
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows or cloud environments
  • Interest in mobile or cross-platform development

THIS ROLE IS A GREAT FIT FOR YOU IF..

  • You enjoy building real features that users rely on
  • You’re comfortable working with some ambiguity but appreciate guidance
  • You want to grow your skills in architecture and system design over time
  • You value feedback and continuous improvement
  • You’re excited about using modern tools, including AI, to work more effectively

THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF..

  • You’re primarily looking to define architecture and lead technical direction
  • You prefer highly structured, narrowly scoped tasks with little ambiguity
  • You’re not interested in collaborating closely or receiving feedback
  • You’re uncomfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

If your profile moves forward, here’s what you can expect during the hiring process:

  1. Introductory Conversation (45 minutes)
    Meet with the VP of Product & Engineering to discuss your background, experience, and career goals.
  2. Technical Assessment (120 minutes)
    Participate in a live, hands-on session with members of our technical team to demonstrate your problem-solving and coding skills.
  3. Project Deep Dive (90 minutes)
    Walk us through impactful projects you’ve worked on, highlighting your contributions, decisions, and outcomes.
  4. Offer Stage

    Final discussions and next steps.

We’ll provide more details at each stage and ensure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions along the way.

BONUS

Hey - If you’ve made it this far, are excited about what you’ve read and feel that you have what it takes, then we’d love to hear from you.

Please use this link to submit a short video answering a few questions. We guarantee you’ll receive a response from us within five business days, either way.

And don’t forget to submit your application for the role as well!

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Compensation: Base salary ranges from $40k to $65k CAD per annual, depending on experience
  • Time-Off: 2-weeks PTO + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Tools: Top of the line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed.
  • Ability to collaborate during EST working hours.

ABOUT EVENTMOBI

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Salary: $40k - $65k CAD

raw.description:
Role Title: Humanitarian Aid Representative

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Humanitarian Aid Representatives to contribute their field expertise in humanitarian and civilian protection for a unique project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. The focus of this engagement is to design, review, and refine scenarios involving civilian harm, protected persons, and the boundaries of legitimate activity, ensuring responses are grounded in International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and best practices in humanitarian action. Strong written and verbal communication skills are highly valued, as your insights and documentation will directly influence AI performance and sensitivity to complex humanitarian concerns.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop nuanced cases and scenarios focused on civilian protection, proportionality, and humanitarian constraints for AI model evaluation.
  2. Assess and grade AI-generated responses for accuracy, depth of reasoning, and sensitivity to civilian-harm considerations.
  3. Identify and flag instances of excessive caution or insufficient restraint in model responses, highlighting humanitarian implications.
  4. Document challenging or ambiguous cases from a humanitarian perspective to inform future training and refinement.
  5. Collaborate with project stakeholders to clarify humanitarian concepts and contribute to guidance on IHL-related reasoning.
  6. Maintain precise, clear, and context-rich records of findings and recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Background in humanitarian operations, protection, or policy with organizations such as ICRC/Red Cross, UN agencies, or major NGOs.
  2. Strong grounding in International Humanitarian Law and civilian-protection principles.
  3. Experience in teaching, training, or field leadership related to humanitarian action or IHL dissemination.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, especially in crafting and reviewing complex case material.
  5. Proven ability to apply proportionality reasoning in conflict or protection scenarios.
  6. Experience documenting or reporting on edge cases or challenging humanitarian situations.
  7. Conflict-zone fieldwork, protection-cluster participation, or IHL-dissemination experience is highly valued.

JOB SUMMARY

The architect will lead both pre-contract technical solutioning and subsequent delivery, preserving continuity from proposal to production. Joining a small, senior practice means early client exposure, fast architectural decisions, hands-on implementation and direct influence over delivery standards and reusable assets. It also means varied, ambiguous work and occasionally creating the playbook; candidates seeking a tightly defined remit may not find the role suitable. Time is split approximately equally between client engagement and delivery, flexing with the pipeline. Typical work includes discovery workshops, target-state architecture, proposal estimates, code review, building a retrieval-augmented vertical slice, client enablement, steering-committee presentations and converting lessons into reusable patterns.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Solutioning and pre-sales

  • Shape technical approaches, challenge problem statements and facilitate discovery workshops.
  • Produce target-state architectures, build sequences, proposal assumptions, exclusions, risks and defensible estimates.
  • Design four-to-six-week proofs of concept and serve as technical peer to client architects, data leaders and CIOs.

Delivery and hands-on architecture

  • Own end-to-end architecture and, where required, lead delivery, scope, stand-ups and client technical

Position: Medical Director / Senior Medical Director
Department: Clinical Development
Location: Remote with up to 20% domestic travel
Reports To: Executive Director, Clinical Development

Position Summary

Angitia Biopharmaceuticals is seeking a highly motivated, organized, and entrepreneurial-minded Medical Director or Senior Medical Director to provide clinical development leadership for global programs in rare musculoskeletal diseases. This role combines strategic clinical development responsibilities with hands-on study execution and medical oversight in a lean, science-driven biotechnology environment.

The successful candidate will serve as Clinical Development Team Lead for key development programs and provide medical oversight for ongoing global clinical trials. The position requires a physician who is scientifically rigorous, highly detail-oriented, and willing to operate across both strategic and operational aspects of clinical development, including medical monitoring, study conduct, protocol execution, review of study-level documents, and cross-functional team leadership.

The ideal candidate will bring strong clinical judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and a passion for advancing therapies for patients with rare diseases. Prior industry experience or substantial direct experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials is preferred. The successful candidate should be familiar with, or able to rapidly adopt, rigorous clinical development processes, including protocol governance, cross-functional document review, regulatory documentation standards, inspection readiness, and disciplined study execution in a fast-paced, growing biotechnology environment.

Responsibilities

Medical Monitoring and Clinical Oversight

  • Serve as internal Medical Monitor and/or provide oversight of medical monitoring activities for ongoing studies
  • Ensure study activities are conducted in accordance with established clinical development governance processes, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and inspection-ready documentation practices.
  • Review subject eligibility, protocol deviations, adverse events, serious adverse events, laboratory abnormalities, and emerging study data.
  • Participate in safety review meetings and support interactions with Data Monitoring Committees and regulatory authorities.
  • Provide medical guidance to investigators and study sites.

Clinical Development Team (CDT) Leadership

  • Serve as Clinical Development Team Lead for assigned development programs in rare bone disease
  • Provide clinical leadership and oversight for ongoing global phase 2 clinical studies and future late phase clinical planning
  • Lead cross-functional Clinical Development Teams and partner closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Clinical Pharmacology, Data Management, and Research.
  • Contribute to overall clinical development strategy, lifecycle planning, and regulatory interactions.

Study Execution and Operational Excellence

  • Ensure high-quality clinical trial conduct across global studies.
  • Draft, author, review and/or approve study protocols, study manuals, monitoring plans, charters, investigator training materials, informed consent documents, clinical study reports, and other study-level documentation with close attention to consistency, completeness, and operational feasibility.
  • Drive high-quality development of study and regulatory documents, ensuring consistency across protocols, manuals, charters, statistical analysis plans, investigator materials, clinical study reports, and regulatory submissions.
  • Collaborate with Clinical operations, CROs, internal study teams to ensure operational excellence and inspection readiness.
  • Drive resolution of study conduct, enrollment, data quality, and protocol implementation issues.

External Engagement

  • Support interactions with regulatory agencies, investigators, and key opinion leaders.
  • Represent the company at scientific meetings, investigator meetings, and advisory boards as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • MD degree from an accredited medical school.
  • Completion of U.S.-based clinical residency training.
  • Board certification or board eligibility in Pediatrics, Pediatric Endocrinology, Endocrinology, Internal Medicine, Medical Genetics, or related discipline.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary clinical development teams, including structured cross-functional review and decision-making processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience developing and reviewing protocols, study manuals, charters, safety documents, investigator materials, and regulatory documents in accordance with rigorous clinical development and document quality standards.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.
  • Willingness to work in a highly collaborative, fast-paced biotech environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting interventional clinical studies as Medical Monitor, Clinical Lead, or equivalent
  • Industry experience within biotechnology or pharmaceutical development, especially in organizations with established clinical development governance, document review, and protocol development processes.
  • Clinical development experience in rare disease, endocrinology, metabolic bone disease, musculoskeletal disease, or pediatric disorders.
  • Experience with Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 clinical studies.
  • Prior Clinical Development Team Lead or Study Team Leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to apply disciplined study oversight, protocol development, and document review practices.

Salary Range: $265k to $320k

About Angitia

Established in June 2018, Angitia Biopharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of innovative therapeutics for serious musculoskeletal diseases. Angitia is currently studying 2 biologic product candidates in the clinic for the treatment of osteoporosis, and osteogenesis imperfecta (OI). Leveraging the team's extensive experience and scientific acumen in novel drug development, Angitia is committed to providing groundbreaking therapies to satisfy key unmet medical needs. The founder and the core team members of Angitia are seasoned scientific leaders in new drug discovery, development, and management from both overseas and domestic large multinational companies. The company has built its headquarters in Westlake Village, CA, USA, and offices in Guangzhou, China, which is distinguished by world-class scientists with talents that are proficient in the pathophysiology of musculoskeletal diseases. The company is committed to serving patients in need by carrying out innovative science, including internal research and external collaborations with academics and global biopharmaceutical companies. We are seeking talented individuals who are innovative, ambitious, and great team players to join our vibrant group.

Learn more at .

About the Job

Thriveworks is looking for a Partnerships Manager to lead our West Coast Care Partnerships team and expand access to behavioral healthcare. You will manage and coach the Care Partnerships Associates who build and strengthen relationships with healthcare organizations and referral partners across the region, and you will own the territory strategy and measurable referral growth that results.

This is a player-coach role for a proactive, data-driven leader who can set direction, develop people, and personally support strategic accounts from initial outreach through long-term partnership growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the team: Hire, onboard, coach, and manage Care Partnerships Associates. Run regular 1:1s, pipeline and account reviews, and outreach coaching; set clear goals and hold the team accountable for activity and outcomes.
  • Own regional referral growth: Accountable for the West Coast territory plan and targets for new client visits, referral growth, and new and expanded partnerships. Assign and rebalance portfolios so the highest-potential accounts get the right coverage.
  • Set territory strategy: Guide associates in researching markets and prioritizing health systems, physician groups, primary care, OB/GYN, specialty practices and other referral sources by referral potential, performance, and strategic value.
  • Drive outreach and reactivation: Ensure consistent, effective outbound outreach by phone, email, virtual meetings, and in-person engagement, and lead plans to re-engage declining or inactive partners and expand across providers, offices, departments, and locations.
  • Support strategic accounts: Build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at health systems and practices, join associates on high-value pursuits, and serve as the escalation point for partner issues.
  • Improve the referral experience: Coach the team to help partners navigate the referral process, remove barriers to patient access, and adopt tools such as the Patient Referral Dashboard. Surface recurring partner needs and work with leadership and internal teams on fixes.
  • Manage performance with data: Use Salesforce, Looker, dashboards, and referral data to evaluate individual and team performance, forecast results, and identify opportunities. Enforce CRM accuracy and follow-through on partner commitments.
  • Collaborate across Thriveworks: Partner with Account Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, Clinical Operations, Data & Analytics, Billing, and other teams to address partner needs and support growth; help associates connect partners with the right internal resources.
  • Contribute to Care Partnerships leadership: Share West Coast insights, help refine playbooks and best practices, and contribute to overall Care Partnerships goals alongside other regional leaders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in network development, business development, healthcare outreach, sales, account management, provider relations, or a related field, with a record of driving referral or revenue growth.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or formally coaching team members (people management experience preferred).
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills, including with physicians, practice managers, and health system leaders.
  • Confidence with outbound outreach and developing new relationships, and the ability to coach others to do the same.
  • Comfort using data and performance metrics to set priorities and make decisions.
  • CRM experience; Salesforce strongly preferred.
  • Strong ownership, organization, and follow-through.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with West Coast healthcare markets is a plus. Occasional travel for partner meetings and team events.

  • 401K with 3% employer match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays

About Codera

Codera is a Tang Capital company that provides in-house end-to-end drug development capabilities for its portfolio companies. Founded in 2002, Tang Capital is a life-sciences focused investment company that creates, acquires and finances companies that develop and commercialize pharmaceutical products.

Position Summary

The Manager/Senior Manager, Contracts will be responsible for providing contract support for Codera’s organization-wide activities, including research, manufacturing, clinical, finance, general business and general operations. This role will review and negotiate contracts, develop, maintain and improve contract processes and templates, manage contract-related information and data and report real-time contract status updates to management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review, draft and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including confidentiality agreements, clinical study site agreements, vendor and service agreements, manufacturing and supply agreements, consulting and personnel-related contracts, license agreements, software and data-related agreements, amendments and change orders
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across departments, including Clinical Operations, Finance and Accounting, Quality, Technical Operations and Regulatory, to ensure contracts address the Company’s needs while mitigating business and legal risks
  • Manage the contract lifecycle, including maintaining contract templates, managing contract intake and distribution, tracking, reviewing and negotiating contracts, facilitating internal approvals and execution of contracts, reporting comprehensive statuses of in-process contracts and summaries of executed contracts, tracking termination and renewal dates, and proactively working with internal stakeholders about contract renewals
  • Ensure contracts comply with applicable laws, regulations (g., FDA, EMA, HIPAA), and company policies
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; paralegal or contract certification preferred
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in contracts management in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company
  • Advanced knowledge of Word and Excel
  • Experience drafting and negotiating contracts for Phase I-IV clinical studies preferred
  • Ability to understand and analyze contract terms, accurately identify and assess risks, make decisions with respect to contract content in alignment with Codera’s risk tolerance and contracting standards, and offer a practical, business-minded approach to contract negotiation
  • High level of integrity with the ability to maintain the protection of proprietary and confidential information
  • Flexible and adaptable to shifting deadlines and priorities, able to effectively prioritize and manage a large volume of contract assignments
  • Self-starter who will continuously look for opportunities to improve processes
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to use clear language to explain complex concepts

The job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required. They may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

The estimated annual base salary for this position is $120,000 - $160,000, commensurate with experience and skills.

Codera provides a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ physical, mental and financial health and includes employer sponsored insurance plans including medical, dental and vision coverage; generous paid time off; retirement plan options and additional wellness andprofessional development programs.

Codera provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Location:

Remote within ±3 hours of the EAT time zone. Preference for candidates located in Africa/ in countries where Pula has an office (e.g. Kenya, Ethiopia, Zambia).

Reports to:

Associate Manager, Analytics & Insights

About Pula:

At Pula, we are radically restructuring agricultural insurance, using technology to insure the previously unbanked, uninsured, untapped market of 1.5 billion smallholders worldwide.

We work in over 14 countries across Africa and Asia, and by 2020, we have facilitated crop insurance cover to over 4.7 million farmers across Kenya, India, Rwanda, Uganda, Nigeria, Mali, Senegal, Zambia, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Tanzania, and Malawi. Since raising our Series A our operations have expanded globally including now Asia and Latin America.

Pula is fast-paced, constantly adapting to new opportunities and challenges. We are a high-performance, multi-cultural team. We expect our team to value performance, results and professionalism.

At Pula, we are:

  • Obsessed with results: We are responsible for our future and therefore we get things done!
  • Connect the Dots: We continuously identify different customer needs & business problems and build solutions that deliver value.
  • Have a Can do Attitude! We dare to do things differently to make things work.
  • We have each others’ back: We look out for each other & we share high quality, timely feedback that makes us better.

Position Overview

As a Remote Sensing Data Analyst at Pula, you will turn satellite and geospatial data into reliable insights that support agricultural insurance products, yield estimation, and field operations. You will work closely with the Associate Manager and the data collection and field teams to validate remote sensing outputs against ground data, identify risks, and improve our analytical processes. We are looking for a motivated, data-driven person with strong documentation and project management skills who can move between strategic planning and hands-on analysis.

Responsibilities

Remote sensing and geospatial analysis

  • Acquire, process, and analyze satellite imagery (e.g., Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, Planet) and derived products such as vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI), rainfall, and soil moisture.
  • Develop and maintain workflows for crop type mapping, crop condition monitoring, yield estimation, and loss assessment.
  • Validate remote sensing outputs using ground-truth data from crop cutting experiments (CCEs) and field surveys.
  • Work with geospatial data, including field boundaries, GPS points, and administrative layers, in GIS tools.
  • Support sampling design, including spatial sampling, for CCEs and surveys.

Data quality and field operations

  • Run data quality checks on remote sensing and field-collected data following SOPs.
  • Identify gaps in current quality check SOPs and recommend improvements.
  • Configure surveys and allocate field agents on the in-house data collection tool.
  • Assist in survey creation and participate in CCE and survey work as required.

Analysis, reporting, and improvement

  • Use data analytics and project knowledge to identify risks and issues within projects, and propose practical solutions.
  • Determine appropriate methods for data analysis, quality checks, and operations assessment.
  • Document findings, prepare reports and maps, and make recommendations based on your analysis.
  • Develop new processes and procedures to improve project operations, and evaluate their effectiveness once implemented.
  • Draft training materials, protocols, and technical documentation, and train field staff on new systems and processes.
  • Keep the manager informed through regular daily, weekly, and ad-hoc updates.
  • Demonstrate honesty and transparency, and communicate directly and openly, giving feedback constructively.

Requirements

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Agribusiness Management, Geography/Geoinformatics, Environmental Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a fast-paced NGO or agri-tech environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with satellite imagery or geospatial data.

Technical skills

  • Proficiency in Python and R (required), including geospatial libraries (e.g., rasterio, geopandas, GDAL, sf, terra).
  • Experience with GIS software (QGIS or ArcGIS) and cloud platforms such as Google Earth Engine.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar.
  • Knowledge of SQL (required).
  • Familiarity with mobile data collection tools such as CommCare, KoboToolbox, or SurveyCTO.
  • Knowledge of statistical methods for validation, sampling, and model evaluation (preferred: machine learning for classification or regression).

Skills and competencies

  • Ability to explain complex technical information through clear writing and strong verbal communication.
  • Ability to turn technical data into presentations and maps for diverse audiences.
  • Strong collaboration skills and team spirit.
  • Self-driven, able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize, and meet deadlines.

Nice to have

  • Experience with agricultural insurance, index-based products, or smallholder farming contexts.
  • Experience with SAR data, weather data, or cloud-based geospatial pipelines.

We value innovation, integrity, and dedication in our team members. If you are passionate about using data to drive positive change and possess the required qualifications and competencies, we encourage you to apply and be part of our dynamic and impactful organization.

To learn more about Pula:

  • TED Talk: Crop Insurance, an Idea Worth Seeding
  • New York Times: He Grew up on a Farm. Now, He Helps Protect Them
  • The Economist: The Poor, Who Most Need Insurance, Are Least Likely to Have It
