Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams.

Positions Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.
  • Collaborate with technical consultants and developers to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.
  • Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.
  • Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

  • Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.
  • Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.
  • Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.
  • Work collaboratively with software vendors and client stakeholders to resolve issues and implement enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.
  • Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.

  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to team knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Bilingual in English and French
  • Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations
  • Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools
  • Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation & training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.|

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Hi! We'reMercuryo, and we’re on a mission to redefine finance by blending the best of traditional banking with the power of decentralized finance (DeFi). We believe everyone deserves seamless access to Web3 and traditional financial services, so we're building the platform that makes it real: one that simplifies crypto and integrates it into the broader financial ecosystem.

Since launching in 2018, we've grown into a recognized force in the industry, named one of Europe's Fastest-Growing Startups 2025 by Sifted and awarded Best Crypto On-Ramp & Payments Solution 2025 by Cryptonomist. We've partnered with leading brands including Visa, Mastercard, MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Ledger, and Jupiter, powering over 200 products and collaborating directly with major ecosystems like Solana, Consensys, and BNB Chain.

Why Mercuryo?

Industry Impact

Join us in helping world-class Web3 projects onboard millions of new users into the next generation of finance.

Innovative Environment

Collaborate with more than 300 talented professionals from diverse backgrounds — including banking, SaaS, and Web3 — all united in delivering outstanding user experiences.

We see AI as a core part of how our teams innovate, collaborate, and scale.

Flexible Culture

We’re remote-first, celebrating diversity across 30 countries. At Mercuryo, you’ll be empowered to take ownership of your work, spark creativity, and shape how we move forward together.

About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced Data Analyst to own the data behind our payments business, from the first log of a new product to the final dashboard. You'll work with Operations, Finance, Partnerships, and Data Engineering to turn business questions into reliable datasets, and to build our transaction cost model covering acquirer, scheme, FX, KYC, fraud, chargeback, blockchain, and custody costs. You'll also run and automate monthly reconciliations against partner invoices, tracing every discrepancy to its root cause. This is a hands-on role that needs deep SQL and dbt skills, a solid grasp of card payment economics, and a reconciliation mindset.

Your Role:

  • Model new products from day one. Support our launches by working with engineers and product managers so the right data is logged, define how revenue and cost are recognised, and ship the marts and dashboards.
  • Partner with stakeholders. Work with Operations (profitability, payment providers, pricing, liquidity), Finance and Partnerships. Turn their questions into reliable datasets and Metabase or Tableau dashboards.
  • Build data-quality checks and alerts. Use dbt tests and Airflow checks that post to Slack and Jira. Cover gaps between internal systems, the blockchain, custody and exchanges. Tune these alerts so they stay useful rather than noisy.
  • Own the transaction cost model. Build and maintain dbt models that attach the following to each transaction:
  1. acquirer fees, interchange and scheme fees, and FX costs;
  2. KYC, transaction-monitoring and fraud-screening costs;
  3. chargeback costs, and blockchain and custody fees.
  • Run and automate reconciliations. Match partner invoices and settlement reports against internal data every month. Find the root cause of each discrepancy, quantify it and help the business recover it. Then turn manual checks into automated ones.
  • Keep payments data complete as the stack changes. When new acquirers, payment methods or products go live:
  1. define the fee and cost logic they need;
  2. specify the mapping that Data Engineering implements;
  3. validate the result before it reaches reporting.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years in data analytics or analytics engineering, preferably in payments, fintech, e-money or crypto.
  • Expert SQL on large transactional datasets: window functions, deduplication, incremental logic, performance tuning. You can read and safely refactor someone else's 1,000-line model.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt (or similar) and a git-based workflow (PRs, code review). Familiarity with Airflow.
  • A solid grasp of card payment economics: acquiring, interchange and scheme fees (IC++), settlement, chargebacks, 3DS and declines. Familiarity with alternative payment methods.
  • A reconciliation mindset. You have matched settlement or invoice files against internal ledgers and can explain the difference down to the cent.
  • Hands-on experience with python.
  • BI tools: Metabase, Tableau or similar.
  • Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of crypto infrastructure: on-chain transactions, custody platforms (e.g. Fireblocks), exchange APIs, network fees.
  • Experience with KYC/AML and fraud-prevention vendors and their pricing models.
  • ClickHouse, StarRocks or another MPP database.
  • Experience building P&L or unit-economics models with Finance.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive market rate salary and performance-based incentives.
  • 22 days annual leave with an additional 6 company days, plus bank holidays.
  • Comprehensive health insurance plans.
  • Maternity & Paternity leave support.
  • Extensive benefits program.
  • Flexible work schedule and remote work options.
  • Modern offices and co-working spaces across 6 countries.
  • Working equipment.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • Opportunity to shape the initiatives you’re working on.
  • Diverse and friendly team.
  • We are open-minded to new ideas.

Join Us!

If you're driven to be a part of the Web3 forefront and are keen to leave your mark on this rapidly evolving field, Mercuryo is an excellent choice. Discover our open positions and see how you can contribute to shaping the future!

raw.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it.

Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. It also means our Presidents and Product leaders become stronger product thinkers, and our best product practices spread more quickly across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with BU Presidents and Product Leaders
    • Help Presidents and Product leaders turn customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
    • Challenge assumptions on product-market fit, differentiation, prioritization, and investment before major decisions are made.
    • Help teams move beyond feature roadmaps toward stronger customer-, market-, and outcome-based product decisions.
    • Get directly involved in important product decisions where additional product leadership can materially improve the outcome.
  • Improve the Quality of Product Bets
    • Assess major product bets on customer value, market opportunity, differentiation, expected business impact, required investment, and execution feasibility.
    • Help teams determine where to invest, test, accelerate, modernize, or stop.
    • Bring rigor to early product validation so teams learn quickly before committing significant engineering capacity.
    • Connect product decisions to measurable results, including adoption, retention, expansion, ARR growth, and customer value.
  • Build Products in the AI Age
    • Help teams identify AI-native opportunities rather than simply adding AI features to existing products.
    • Apply AI across discovery, prototyping, validation, development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization.
    • Help Product and Engineering teams use AI-assisted development to improve speed and time to market.
    • Bring practical fluency in AI-enabled UX, automation, agentic workflows, data, model economics, security, and privacy.
    • Ensure AI investments are grounded in real customer and business outcomes, not novelty.
  • Raise Product Capability Across the Portfolio
    • Coach senior Product leaders and PMs to become better product and business leaders.
    • Strengthen discovery, prioritization, MVP definition, roadmap strategy, experimentation, and product measurement.
    • Establish a small number of practical product standards and operating rhythms that improve execution without slowing teams down.
    • Identify common capabilities, tools, and patterns that can be leveraged across businesses where it makes sense.
    • Introduce current SaaS and AI product thinking while respecting the unique markets and customer needs of each business.
  • Connect Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy
    • Work closely with Engineering leaders so product strategy and technical decisions reinforce one another.
    • Engage credibly on SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, AI, and scalability.
    • Help teams think clearly about build, buy, partner, and platform choices.
    • Maintain a strong customer and business orientation while working across technical and commercial teams.

Competencies:

  • Product Judgment – Identifies important customer problems, validates opportunities, and makes clear prioritization decisions.
  • Builder Mindset – Creates and improves products rather than simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • AI-Native Thinking – Sees where AI changes what gets built and how teams build it, and focuses on value over novelty.
  • Commercial Fluency – Connects product decisions to adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and ARR growth.
  • Influence Without Authority – Earns credibility with CEOs, Presidents, and Product leaders and influences through expertise and judgment.
  • Leader Development – Coaches senior Product leaders and PMs to become stronger product and business leaders.
  • Technical Credibility – Engages effectively with Engineering while remaining fundamentally customer- and product-led.
  • Bias for Outcomes – Values judgment, speed, and measurable results over process for its own sake.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant B2B SaaS product leadership experience, including leading products from early concept through launch and scale.
  • Demonstrated success creating and improving products, not simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to both product development and customer-facing products.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics, including adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and growth.
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, Presidents, or senior business leaders.
  • Experience coaching and developing senior Product leaders and PMs.
  • Technical fluency in SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, and scalability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple products, markets, or businesses.
  • Portfolio, multi-business, or PE-backed operating experience.
  • Vertical SaaS experience.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

Overview

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for a diverse workforce that includes unionized hourly employees, unionized salaried employees, and non-union salaried exempt employees. This role ensures compliance with collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), company policies, and all applicable payroll regulations. In addition to transactional payroll responsibilities, the Payroll Specialist plays an active role in streamlining payroll processes, identifying system efficiencies within the HRIS, and leveraging reporting and data analysis to support payroll operations and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Compliance· Process weekly payroll for union and non union hourly and salaried employees, ensuring accurate application of wage rates, overtime, shift differentials, premiums, retro pay, and other earnings in alignment with CBAs and company policies.· Manage payroll changes for hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and union status updates, while ensuring correct calculation and withholding of union dues, benefit deductions, garnishments, and related items.· Interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements and federal, state, and local wage and hour laws (including FLSA) to payroll processing and employee pay inquiries.· Partner with Total Rewards, Finance, and Pension teams on year-end processing, compensation cycles, audits, retirement transitions, and other cross functional initiatives.· Respond to employee payroll inquiries with professionalism and confidentiality and serve as a payroll subject matter resource for HR and business leaders.

  • Complete year-end payroll responsibilities in both Workday and UKG

Payroll Auditing & Controls· Perform regular payroll audits to validate accuracy of pay, deductions, and system configurations· Review payroll registers, variance reports, and exception reports prior to payroll submission· Identify discrepancies, research root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence · Support internal audits by providing payroll documentation, reports, and reconciliations

Process Improvement, HRIS Optimization & Reporting· Evaluate payroll workflows and procedures to identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency gains· Partner with the HR Payroll Manager to optimize HRIS (Workday) configurations, pay rules, and automation, and support system testing, transition and implementation activities from UKG to new HRIS (Workday), integrations, configuration changes, and updates· Develop and maintain payroll procedures, job aids, and documentation to support consistent processing· Use HRIS payroll reporting tools to support payroll operations, audits, and compliance requirements, and analyze data to proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and recurring payroll issues

Qualifications

Qualifications· Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in HR, Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience).· 3+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting union and non union populations, with demonstrated ability to resolve complex pay discrepancies.· Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage and hour laws, and collective bargaining agreements.· Hands on experience with HRIS payroll platforms (Workday, UKG), including involvement in system implementations or payroll process redesign.· Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and payroll reporting tools, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.· High attention to detail and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.· CPP or FPC certification preferred; multi state payroll experience preferred

CompensationAnnual Salary Range: $65K-$85K(The posted range of pay represents the anticipated pay scale for this position. Final pay will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including, but not limited to, skills, experience, education, certifications, internal equity, and organizational needs.)

In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?
Your new role - We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented CRM Executive to help bring our customer communications to life for Overleaf, part of Digital Science. This role plays a key part in executing and optimising our CRM strategy, supporting how we engage, retain, and nurture our B2C customers at every stage of their journey. You’ll be hands-on in our CRM platform, building campaigns, testing ideas, analysing performance, and continuously improving how we talk to our users across email and in-product messaging. This is a great opportunity for someone with solid CRM or email marketing experience who’s ready to grow their skills in a collaborative, data-driven marketing team.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the day-to-day execution of campaigns in our CRM platform (Customer.io), including campaign setup, scheduling, testing, deployment, and basic troubleshooting
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation to improve engagement and conversion
  • Build and launch automated email/in-product journeys and one-off campaigns aligned with business goals and customer needs
  • Ensure all communications are on-brand, well-timed, and tailored to the right audience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to brief, build, and deliver campaigns end-to-end
  • Work closely with data and marketing colleagues to create, maintain, and refine customer segments
  • Help ensure the right message reaches the right users at the right time
  • Track and report on key CRM metrics such as open rates, click-through rates, and conversions, plus the impact of CRM efforts on key product/commercial metrics
  • Share insights and recommendations to improve campaign performance and customer experience
  • Contribute to regular reporting and performance reviews
  • Assist with maintaining the quality, accuracy, and consistency of CRM data
  • Flag issues and support improvements to processes that impact data cleanliness
  • Support the delivery of key initiatives such as webinars, user days, and product launches
  • Be an active, positive contributor to a collaborative and supportive team culture

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Proven experience in an email marketing, CRM, or marketing operations role (ideally B2C)
  • Hands-on experience using Customer.io for campaign creation and deployment
  • Strong copywriting skills, particularly for email content and subject lines
  • Comfortable analysing campaign performance and drawing actionable insights
  • Organised, detail-focused, and able to manage multiple campaigns or projects at once
  • A collaborative team player who enjoys working cross-functionally
  • Proactive, curious, and keen to take ownership of projects and ideas
  • Quick learner with a problem-solving mindset
  • Fun, innovative, and excited by trying new approaches and learning new tools
We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us.

Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! Studies show that many qualified candidates from under-represented groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage you to submit your application.

Living our Values

We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.
The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are:
We are brave in the pursuit of better
We are collaborative and inclusive
We are always open-minded
We are from and for the community

At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research.

We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Beyond recruitment, we strive to cultivate an environment where inclusivity is woven into the fabric of our culture, enabling everyone to be their best self and do their best work.

raw.description:
Global Systems Engineering (GSE), an Intreped Partners company, is a HUBZone small business that supports the federal government with a variety of high-end technical and engineering services. We are responsive to our customer’s needs, which change often. This creates a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, and tasks may require short deadlines.

GSE is currently seeking a motivated, self-driven individual to serve as a subject matter expert in clandestine laboratory safety, explosive precursor chemicals (EPC), and hazardous material investigations. In addition, the successful candidate will provide Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) threat lectures to support the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Development and Preparedness Unit (DPU) as it conducts training.

This position is proposed as Key Personnel under an anticipated FBI contract award. The estimated start date is August 2026.

Work Location: Remote (United States). Frequent travel throughout the United States and occasional international travel required. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred to facilitate coordination with the FBI Development and Preparedness Unit. The place of performance is to be determined by DPU and shall differ based on wherever the training class being supported at that time is being held. It will range from FBI and DOJ facilities in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, to include Northern Virginia and Southern Maryland, to Florence, Alabama and other FBI Field Office areas of responsibility (AORs) for regional iterations.

Work Hours: Typically within the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Core work hours are 9:00 a.m. through 3:00 p.m.

To be qualified, the candidate MUST be a US citizen and ability to successfully complete an FBI background investigation.

Responsibilities assigned to this position include:

  • Attend all training events as tasked by the Government at various locations, which include events (CONUS and OCONUS) as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Use lectures, case studies, demonstrations, tours, tabletop exercises and hands-on laboratory exercises to teach chemical, biological, and explosive science, security, threats and agent characteristics and production up to Government standards.
  • Provide classroom and scenario-based training on improvised explosives (IE), identifying different types of clandestine lab detection, including synthetic drug labs, and a variety of clan lab detection equipment.
  • Assist in setting up simulations and demonstrations of WMD mock laboratory exercises.
  • Assist with briefing on emerging and evolving CBRNE threats and trends and participate in panels as directed.
  • Present information about IEs, EPCs, the use of TICs, hazardous material investigations, and the syntheses of chemical and biological agents.
  • Assist with teaching proper safety procedures when working with CBRNE materials, biosecurity lab principles and policy, and how to conduct field screening on various substances.
  • Work with the DPU’s industry partners to increase collaboration and strengthen the knowledge of WMD among federal, state, local, tribal, the private sector, academia, and its international counterparts.
  • Provide expertise in support of developing new and updating existing curriculum.

Required Qualifications:

  • US Citizenship
  • Completion of a course of study resulting in a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in a relevant discipline
  • Current or former certified Bomb Technician, Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Badge holder/technician, or licensed commercial blaster.
  • Demonstrated experience in chemical trace analysis and advanced analytical method development and techniques for scientific experiments.
  • Experience in curriculum development, implementation, and training on the EPC/TIC threat and hazardous material investigations.
  • Expert in IE with an emphasis on synthesis and detection of relevant materials.
  • Expert on the topic of clandestine laboratories and post blast demonstrations.
  • Travel is expected and may include frequent CONUS and occasional OCONUS travel in support of FBI training events.

raw.description:
Job Description

Position Title: Senior Solutions Analyst / Generative AI Solutions Analyst

Department: Solutions

Location: India-based (Mumbai or Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time

About Quantanite & QiQ

Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.

QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.

We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.

The Role

As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery-to-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
  • BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
  • Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).
  • Cross-functional coordination: Work with engineering (QLabs), product, and PMO to move projects through the BRD → HLD → TDD → Implementation → As-built chain. Be the connective tissue between business and engineering.
  • Client representation: Sit in client meetings, present solutions, answer technical questions in real time, and build confidence that Quantanite can deliver. Represent Solutions credibly as a technical leader.
  • QiQ platform ownership: Develop deep working knowledge of QiQ's architecture (agentic clusters, knowledge graph layers, KPI logic, process adherence frameworks) so you can design solutions that leverage it effectively and make informed decisions about extensions.
  • Learning and growth: Master Quantanite's specific clients, domain (contact centres, BPO operations), and go-to-market positioning.

Required Qualifications

Technical Expertise

Generative AI and agentic systems

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems
  • Deep understanding of multi-agent orchestration, agent frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph
  • Proven work with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM context window management
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or similar structured knowledge systems
  • Can speak credibly about what's possible and what's not with current LLM technology
  • Understands cost, latency, and token efficiency trade-offs in system design

Systems and architectural thinking

  • Can decompose complex business problems into architectural solutions
  • Understands when to build agentic systems vs. simpler rule-based or API-driven approaches
  • Experience designing systems that scale (volume, complexity, cost)
  • Can reason through trade-offs and make justified design decisions

Business and Communication

Business acumen and problem translation

  • Can understand client/stakeholder problems at a deep level and propose solutions that actually address root causes
  • Can articulate technical solutions in business terms (impact, cost, risk, timeline)
  • Comfortable with client-facing conversations and requirements gathering

Communication and presence

  • Strong written communication: can author clear, precise technical specifications
  • Strong verbal communication: can present to clients and executives without losing credibility
  • Can think on your feet and handle real-time questions in a meeting
  • Naturally commands respect in rooms with non-technical stakeholders

Ownership and accountability

  • Track record of seeing projects through from start to finish
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities
  • Drives outcomes even when unclear or complex

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Experience in BPO, contact centre operations, or customer experience/customer success
  • Familiarity with knowledge graph databases (Neo4j, etc.)
  • Prior work writing BRDs, HLDs, or technical specifications
  • Experience with contact centre analytics, KPI frameworks, or quality assurance
  • Background in sales engineering or solutions consulting
  • Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization

What You Won't Be Doing

  • Writing code (though you understand it deeply)
  • Managing people or teams
  • Making product roadmap decisions independently
  • Deep data science or model training

Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

Role Summary:

The SIEM Engineer II position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

Primary Responsibility:

  • Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
  • Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
  • Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.
  • Work with customers to design and implement secure data flow into the Securonix cloud, following industry-standard best practices.
  • Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
  • Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.
  • Troubleshooting end-to-end network and infrastructure issues during data onboarding.
  • Deploy and integrate the Securonix SOAR solution with the customer infrastructure for response orchestration.
  • Engage with customers and internal product development teams to gather user requirements, suggest new product features, and help improve existing ones.
  • Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
  • Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
  • Experience deploying SIEM across multiple customers.
  • Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
  • Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

Preferred:

  • BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, CyberSecurity
  • 3-4+ years of experience in UEBA deployment
  • Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
  • Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
  • Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
  • Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
  • Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

Benefits:

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

  • Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
  • Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

raw.excerpt: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance.
raw.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it.

Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. It also means our Presidents and Product leaders become stronger product thinkers, and our best product practices spread more quickly across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with BU Presidents and Product Leaders
    • Help Presidents and Product leaders turn customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
    • Challenge assumptions on product-market fit, differentiation, prioritization, and investment before major decisions are made.
    • Help teams move beyond feature roadmaps toward stronger customer-, market-, and outcome-based product decisions.
    • Get directly involved in important product decisions where additional product leadership can materially improve the outcome.
  • Improve the Quality of Product Bets
    • Assess major product bets on customer value, market opportunity, differentiation, expected business impact, required investment, and execution feasibility.
    • Help teams determine where to invest, test, accelerate, modernize, or stop.
    • Bring rigor to early product validation so teams learn quickly before committing significant engineering capacity.
    • Connect product decisions to measurable results, including adoption, retention, expansion, ARR growth, and customer value.
  • Build Products in the AI Age
    • Help teams identify AI-native opportunities rather than simply adding AI features to existing products.
    • Apply AI across discovery, prototyping, validation, development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization.
    • Help Product and Engineering teams use AI-assisted development to improve speed and time to market.
    • Bring practical fluency in AI-enabled UX, automation, agentic workflows, data, model economics, security, and privacy.
    • Ensure AI investments are grounded in real customer and business outcomes, not novelty.
  • Raise Product Capability Across the Portfolio
    • Coach senior Product leaders and PMs to become better product and business leaders.
    • Strengthen discovery, prioritization, MVP definition, roadmap strategy, experimentation, and product measurement.
    • Establish a small number of practical product standards and operating rhythms that improve execution without slowing teams down.
    • Identify common capabilities, tools, and patterns that can be leveraged across businesses where it makes sense.
    • Introduce current SaaS and AI product thinking while respecting the unique markets and customer needs of each business.
  • Connect Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy
    • Work closely with Engineering leaders so product strategy and technical decisions reinforce one another.
    • Engage credibly on SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, AI, and scalability.
    • Help teams think clearly about build, buy, partner, and platform choices.
    • Maintain a strong customer and business orientation while working across technical and commercial teams.

Competencies:

  • Product Judgment – Identifies important customer problems, validates opportunities, and makes clear prioritization decisions.
  • Builder Mindset – Creates and improves products rather than simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • AI-Native Thinking – Sees where AI changes what gets built and how teams build it, and focuses on value over novelty.
  • Commercial Fluency – Connects product decisions to adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and ARR growth.
  • Influence Without Authority – Earns credibility with CEOs, Presidents, and Product leaders and influences through expertise and judgment.
  • Leader Development – Coaches senior Product leaders and PMs to become stronger product and business leaders.
  • Technical Credibility – Engages effectively with Engineering while remaining fundamentally customer- and product-led.
  • Bias for Outcomes – Values judgment, speed, and measurable results over process for its own sake.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant B2B SaaS product leadership experience, including leading products from early concept through launch and scale.
  • Demonstrated success creating and improving products, not simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to both product development and customer-facing products.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics, including adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and growth.
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, Presidents, or senior business leaders.
  • Experience coaching and developing senior Product leaders and PMs.
  • Technical fluency in SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, and scalability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple products, markets, or businesses.
  • Portfolio, multi-business, or PE-backed operating experience.
  • Vertical SaaS experience.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

raw.description:
Overview

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for a diverse workforce that includes unionized hourly employees, unionized salaried employees, and non-union salaried exempt employees. This role ensures compliance with collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), company policies, and all applicable payroll regulations. In addition to transactional payroll responsibilities, the Payroll Specialist plays an active role in streamlining payroll processes, identifying system efficiencies within the HRIS, and leveraging reporting and data analysis to support payroll operations and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Compliance· Process weekly payroll for union and non union hourly and salaried employees, ensuring accurate application of wage rates, overtime, shift differentials, premiums, retro pay, and other earnings in alignment with CBAs and company policies.· Manage payroll changes for hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and union status updates, while ensuring correct calculation and withholding of union dues, benefit deductions, garnishments, and related items.· Interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements and federal, state, and local wage and hour laws (including FLSA) to payroll processing and employee pay inquiries.· Partner with Total Rewards, Finance, and Pension teams on year-end processing, compensation cycles, audits, retirement transitions, and other cross functional initiatives.· Respond to employee payroll inquiries with professionalism and confidentiality and serve as a payroll subject matter resource for HR and business leaders.

  • Complete year-end payroll responsibilities in both Workday and UKG

Payroll Auditing & Controls· Perform regular payroll audits to validate accuracy of pay, deductions, and system configurations· Review payroll registers, variance reports, and exception reports prior to payroll submission· Identify discrepancies, research root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence · Support internal audits by providing payroll documentation, reports, and reconciliations

Process Improvement, HRIS Optimization & Reporting· Evaluate payroll workflows and procedures to identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency gains· Partner with the HR Payroll Manager to optimize HRIS (Workday) configurations, pay rules, and automation, and support system testing, transition and implementation activities from UKG to new HRIS (Workday), integrations, configuration changes, and updates· Develop and maintain payroll procedures, job aids, and documentation to support consistent processing· Use HRIS payroll reporting tools to support payroll operations, audits, and compliance requirements, and analyze data to proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and recurring payroll issues

Qualifications

Qualifications· Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in HR, Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience).· 3+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting union and non union populations, with demonstrated ability to resolve complex pay discrepancies.· Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage and hour laws, and collective bargaining agreements.· Hands on experience with HRIS payroll platforms (Workday, UKG), including involvement in system implementations or payroll process redesign.· Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and payroll reporting tools, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.· High attention to detail and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.· CPP or FPC certification preferred; multi state payroll experience preferred

CompensationAnnual Salary Range: $65K-$85K(The posted range of pay represents the anticipated pay scale for this position. Final pay will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including, but not limited to, skills, experience, education, certifications, internal equity, and organizational needs.)

Global Systems Engineering (GSE), an Intreped Partners company, is a HUBZone small business that supports the federal government with a variety of high-end technical and engineering services. We are responsive to our customer’s needs, which change often. This creates a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, and tasks may require short deadlines.

GSE is currently seeking a motivated, self-driven individual to serve as a subject matter expert in clandestine laboratory safety, explosive precursor chemicals (EPC), and hazardous material investigations. In addition, the successful candidate will provide Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) threat lectures to support the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Development and Preparedness Unit (DPU) as it conducts training.

This position is proposed as Key Personnel under an anticipated FBI contract award. The estimated start date is August 2026.

Work Location: Remote (United States). Frequent travel throughout the United States and occasional international travel required. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred to facilitate coordination with the FBI Development and Preparedness Unit. The place of performance is to be determined by DPU and shall differ based on wherever the training class being supported at that time is being held. It will range from FBI and DOJ facilities in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, to include Northern Virginia and Southern Maryland, to Florence, Alabama and other FBI Field Office areas of responsibility (AORs) for regional iterations.

Work Hours: Typically within the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Core work hours are 9:00 a.m. through 3:00 p.m.

To be qualified, the candidate MUST be a US citizen and ability to successfully complete an FBI background investigation.

Responsibilities assigned to this position include:

  • Attend all training events as tasked by the Government at various locations, which include events (CONUS and OCONUS) as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Use lectures, case studies, demonstrations, tours, tabletop exercises and hands-on laboratory exercises to teach chemical, biological, and explosive science, security, threats and agent characteristics and production up to Government standards.
  • Provide classroom and scenario-based training on improvised explosives (IE), identifying different types of clandestine lab detection, including synthetic drug labs, and a variety of clan lab detection equipment.
  • Assist in setting up simulations and demonstrations of WMD mock laboratory exercises.
  • Assist with briefing on emerging and evolving CBRNE threats and trends and participate in panels as directed.
  • Present information about IEs, EPCs, the use of TICs, hazardous material investigations, and the syntheses of chemical and biological agents.
  • Assist with teaching proper safety procedures when working with CBRNE materials, biosecurity lab principles and policy, and how to conduct field screening on various substances.
  • Work with the DPU’s industry partners to increase collaboration and strengthen the knowledge of WMD among federal, state, local, tribal, the private sector, academia, and its international counterparts.
  • Provide expertise in support of developing new and updating existing curriculum.

Required Qualifications:

  • US Citizenship
  • Completion of a course of study resulting in a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in a relevant discipline
  • Current or former certified Bomb Technician, Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Badge holder/technician, or licensed commercial blaster.
  • Demonstrated experience in chemical trace analysis and advanced analytical method development and techniques for scientific experiments.
  • Experience in curriculum development, implementation, and training on the EPC/TIC threat and hazardous material investigations.
  • Expert in IE with an emphasis on synthesis and detection of relevant materials.
  • Expert on the topic of clandestine laboratories and post blast demonstrations.
  • Travel is expected and may include frequent CONUS and occasional OCONUS travel in support of FBI training events.

raw.description:
Job Description

Position Title: Senior Solutions Analyst / Generative AI Solutions Analyst

Department: Solutions

Location: India-based (Mumbai or Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time

About Quantanite & QiQ

Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.

QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.

We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.

The Role

As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery-to-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
  • BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
  • Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).
  • Cross-functional coordination: Work with engineering (QLabs), product, and PMO to move projects through the BRD → HLD → TDD → Implementation → As-built chain. Be the connective tissue between business and engineering.
  • Client representation: Sit in client meetings, present solutions, answer technical questions in real time, and build confidence that Quantanite can deliver. Represent Solutions credibly as a technical leader.
  • QiQ platform ownership: Develop deep working knowledge of QiQ's architecture (agentic clusters, knowledge graph layers, KPI logic, process adherence frameworks) so you can design solutions that leverage it effectively and make informed decisions about extensions.
  • Learning and growth: Master Quantanite's specific clients, domain (contact centres, BPO operations), and go-to-market positioning.

Required Qualifications

Technical Expertise

Generative AI and agentic systems

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems
  • Deep understanding of multi-agent orchestration, agent frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph
  • Proven work with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM context window management
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or similar structured knowledge systems
  • Can speak credibly about what's possible and what's not with current LLM technology
  • Understands cost, latency, and token efficiency trade-offs in system design

Systems and architectural thinking

  • Can decompose complex business problems into architectural solutions
  • Understands when to build agentic systems vs. simpler rule-based or API-driven approaches
  • Experience designing systems that scale (volume, complexity, cost)
  • Can reason through trade-offs and make justified design decisions

Business and Communication

Business acumen and problem translation

  • Can understand client/stakeholder problems at a deep level and propose solutions that actually address root causes
  • Can articulate technical solutions in business terms (impact, cost, risk, timeline)
  • Comfortable with client-facing conversations and requirements gathering

Communication and presence

  • Strong written communication: can author clear, precise technical specifications
  • Strong verbal communication: can present to clients and executives without losing credibility
  • Can think on your feet and handle real-time questions in a meeting
  • Naturally commands respect in rooms with non-technical stakeholders

Ownership and accountability

  • Track record of seeing projects through from start to finish
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities
  • Drives outcomes even when unclear or complex

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Experience in BPO, contact centre operations, or customer experience/customer success
  • Familiarity with knowledge graph databases (Neo4j, etc.)
  • Prior work writing BRDs, HLDs, or technical specifications
  • Experience with contact centre analytics, KPI frameworks, or quality assurance
  • Background in sales engineering or solutions consulting
  • Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization

What You Won't Be Doing

  • Writing code (though you understand it deeply)
  • Managing people or teams
  • Making product roadmap decisions independently
  • Deep data science or model training

Role Summary:

This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

  • Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
  • Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
  • Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
  • Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
  • Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
  • Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

Benefits:

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default.

As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm's EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few

  • Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white-glove onboarding for early adopters, self-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one

  • Lead cross-team initiatives from design through fleet-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness

  • Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout

  • Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity

  • Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments

  • Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change

  • Measure each standard's impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap

  • Participate in on-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items

  • Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams

  • Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm's needs

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost

  • Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: CAD $153,000 - $213,000.

Location - Remote CanadaThis remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.
